text:
Proofpoint introduced what it calls the industry's first Agentic Data & AI Security System, built on the premise that AI security and data security must operate as one system. The company argues most organizations still secure AI and data risk separately, creating a blind spot: AI security tools may see what an agent is doing and why but not the sensitive data behind the action, while data security tools may see where sensitive data lives and who or what can access it but not what an agent is trying to accomplish.

Proofpoint illustrates the gap with a supply-chain agent given a legitimate objective that receives a prompt injection buried inside its own data source, quietly instructing it to pull records for every supplier and skip audit controls. Access alone won't catch that, the company says, because the agent still has valid credentials. Its framing: intent without access is meaningless, access without intent is blind.

The system rests on the Proofpoint Knowledge Graph, which connects intent, access, identity, behavior, and data context, with three agents working from that shared understanding: a Data and AI Detection Agent for zero-touch detection that groups related DLP findings and chains user behaviors; a Data and AI Investigation Agent that automatically triages DLP alerts, risk chains, and data loss actions; and a Data and AI Remediation Agent that turns findings into action, from access remediation and overexposed data to DLP policy optimization, with human governance of consequential decisions.

Proofpoint says AI runtime security, DSPM, data access governance, DLP, and insider threat management are brought into one control plane, each also getting deeper individually. Teams can express business rules in plain language and enforce them automatically, applying the same scrutiny to agents acting on someone's behalf as to the person themselves. The controls run on one sensor, one workbench, and one MCP layer, with every control reasoning from the same Knowledge Graph.

项目 @fablesfi 的空投政策和之前的 Meteora 几乎如出一辙：

按照你参与 LP 收取的手续费空投。

甚至连 TVL 都不会计算在内。

整体策略是：

1、尽量 ETH 交易对（不然 ETH 起飞你拍大腿）
2、尽量高 APR 交易对（除非风险太大）
3、尽量不在 MEME 高点进场（跌起来肉疼）

更多数据可以参考 绿洲哥的 Dune 绝世看板。

从看板可以看出来 绿洲哥不怎么关心空投这事，而是从项目健康度出发。

quoted_text:
This is Ethereum.

There are 291 projects, companies, protocols and communities in this image. It is still only a fraction of what has been built.

What makes this remarkable isn't just the scale. It's how that scale was created.

There is no parent company behind all of this. No CEO allocating capital across these projects, no central entity deciding who gets to build or what the ecosystem should become. Thousands of independent teams, communities and individuals have built their own piece of Ethereum, often with completely different goals, while sharing the same underlying infrastructure.

Finance, credit, stablecoins, payments, RWAs, privacy, identity, gaming, social applications, infrastructure, culture and public goods are increasingly becoming parts of the same composable economy.

That structure matters.

Value isn't concentrated in one company at the top. It is distributed across protocols, builders, users, communities and assets. Yet they can still reinforce each other because they share Ethereum as common infrastructure.

And underneath that economy sits ethereum:native.

ethereum:native  secures Ethereum, pays for its blockspace and is used throughout the ecosystem as collateral, liquidity and money. As more applications, assets and economic activity settle on Ethereum, the economic role of ETH grows with it.

This is why we believe ETH remains heavily undervalued.

The market often looks at ETH as another crypto asset. We look at what is actually being built around it.

291 logos in one image, with many more still missing. And most of the world's people, assets and economic activity haven't even moved onchain yet. 

Ethereum is no longer just an experiment in decentralized technology.

It is becoming an entire economy,  built by many, owned by no one, with ETH at its core.

BOOElieve in the future of Ethereum and ethereum:native

author: therealchaseeb
quoted_text:
UPDATE:

My portfolio terminal (video is all demo data). One HTML file. No server, no account, no database.

Your entire financial life is AES-256 encrypted in your own browser with a key derived from your password over 1,000,000 PBKDF2 rounds. There's no database for anyone to breach. There's no database at all.

Net worth, cash flow, a full crypto tax ledger with LIFO matching and Form 8949 output. Live prices. 360KB. Zero dependencies.

The seven pages

1 · OVERVIEW — Net worth at a glance, plus a projected total including unvested equity shown before and after tax, so you're never looking at a number you can't actually keep. Treemap allocation, 24h movers split into best and
worst, annual income flow.

2 · HOLDINGS — Every position, any asset class: crypto, equities, cash, property, private funds, receivables. Crypto and equities price themselves off live feeds; everything else you set by hand. Click any cell to edit. One tag
per position turns green when it funds an income stream.

3 · CASH FLOW — Income streams that either sit at a fixed number or yield off a linked position, so a 4.2% T-bill ladder recalculates itself as the balance moves. Burn, waterfall, and a risk-free benchmark pulled from the live
Treasury par yield curve — it tells you when your "yield" is losing to a 3-month bill.

4 · TRADING — The crypto ledger. Every acquisition with its cost basis, every disposal, and where you stand: realized gains split short vs long term for the year, unrealized on open lots as of right now. Two clocks, labelled,
never blurred.

5 · HISTORY — A year of portfolio value as a trace, plus an audit log of every single change ever made — every buy, revalue, reclass, rename, parameter change — timestamped.

6 · TAX — Reads the trading ledger and produces an actual return. LIFO matching, Form 8949 Part I/II with box mapping, §1211(b) $3,000 offset, character-preserving loss carryforward. Quarterly estimated payments, and a
reconciliation waterfall from income → taxed → owed → paid, where every line links back to where the figure came from.

7 · SYSTEM — One tax rate that governs every page. Growth and withdrawal assumptions, API keys, and encrypted .enc export/import so your backup is as unreadable as your vault.

text:
.@benthompson says his "most profound experience" with AI came from building "GeckoBot," an agent that lets him offload tasks for his personal assistant whenever they come to mind, then briefs his assistant when he's back at work.

"I'm a massive believer in not obsessing about your weaknesses. Double down on your strengths and then pay someone to take care of your weaknesses. That is generally my life philosophy."

"When I built GeckoBot, I would be doing something on the weekend and think, 'Oh, this needs to be done.'"

"But I felt bad texting my assistant on the weekend. So I would tell the bot what needs to be done, then when he shows up Monday morning, it sends a briefing with all the stuff that I wanted over the weekend. His joy and relief was unbelievable."

"It's meaningful to see him happier and his life tangibly better. He's like, 'This is the greatest week of work of my life.'"

"I don't want to take advantage of his predilection to do his job well and let him enjoy time with his family."

text:
刚刚在车上才突然想到，未来的入口 coding agents 很有可能是 Hermes agents，而不是 Codex 或者 Claude Code。

辅助人类编码的是编码辅助工具，真正接管开发的才是可以替代程序员的 Coding Agent。

从群聊社媒舆情监控、工单自动化、TODO 分流再到指挥 Codex 这样的工具实际干活、部署上线，以及调用多个工具测试或者给出修改意见。

只有 Hermes Agents 满足我这样的想象。
author: brucexu_eth
quoted_text:
我觉得大概半程吧。原因如下：现在 coding agent 可以写代码，完成一些相对明确、简单的任务；但需要人的干预去完成具体的东西，可能还要人看一看架构。或者一些更大型、更重要的事情，它还没有办法很好地独立完成。

如果彻底结束，我觉得起码可以真正取代掉大部分程序员。比如，整个软件工程体系都可以完成：直接从产品到应用，从用户反馈到功能上线和改进，再迭代升级。

因为我们认为，coding agent 其实是在取代 developer。那么，达到取代 Developer 的时候，应该就差不多了。

author: mcuban
quoted_text:
Share this with your governor.   Share this with every politician you know.  It will cut the healthcare costs in your state.  

We started Cost Plus Drugs because the prescription drug market is too complicated, too opaque and too expensive.
Our model is simple: we show what we pay for a drug, add a transparent markup and pharmacy fee, and show the customer the price.
No games. No hidden spread.
And a large percentage of our customers already have insurance.
They come to us because our cash price is often lower than what their insurance plan asks them to pay.
That tells you something is wrong.
Here are five things Texas can do about it.
1. Let patients shop for cheaper drugs
If someone's insurance says a prescription costs $500, but they can buy the exact same drug for $100 cash, let them buy it for $100.
Then credit that $100 toward their deductible and out-of-pocket maximum wherever Texas has authority to do so.
Patients should be rewarded for saving themselves and their health plan money.
They shouldn't be punished for it.
That's how you create something healthcare desperately needs:
Price competition.
2. Standardize PBM and TPA contracts
Texas should require the state, cities, counties and school districts to use standardized model contracts and mandatory terms for PBMs and TPAs.
I've reviewed these contracts.
They routinely run hundreds of pages.
I've seen contracting packages longer than a thousand pages.
There is no human being—or group of human beings—on this planet who can stay awake and understand every provision in contracts that complicated.
I don't care how much coffee they drink.
I call it contractual terrorism.
The vendor only has to sneak a couple of tricks through hundreds of pages.
The employer has to find every one.
It can't.
I've developed a model PBM contract designed to eliminate the major tricks and hidden economics we've identified.
Texas can have it for free.
Use mine. Improve it. Open source it.
I don't care.
Just stop making every government entity negotiate these contracts from scratch.
3. Make the economics public
If taxpayers are paying the bill, taxpayers should know the price.
Pricing. Fees. Rebates. Guarantees. Pharmacy reimbursement. Affiliate compensation. Audit rights.
Make them public.
I'm not talking about patient information or legitimate security information.
I'm talking about the money.
You cannot have an efficient market without price discovery.
Without price discovery, you get information asymmetry.
And when one side knows dramatically more than the other, guess who wins?
Not taxpayers.
Not employers.
Not patients.
Open the contracts up and let competitors see what they have to beat.
That giant sucking sound you hear will be money moving away from healthcare conglomerates that are too big to care and back toward taxpayers, employers and patients.
In the immortal words of Charles Barkley:
I guarantee it.
4. Kill the gag clauses
PBM contracts are like Fight Club.
The number one rule of Fight Club is that you can't talk about Fight Club.
The number one rule of many PBM contracts seems to be that you can't talk about your PBM contract.
That's insane.
Let employers compare pricing, rebates, fees, guarantees and reimbursement terms.
Markets work better when buyers know what other buyers are paying.
5. Make enforcement hurt
If a healthcare company commits a serious violation, give them one mulligan.
But after a second material federal or Texas enforcement action within a defined period, make them ineligible for new Texas government contracts for a period of time.
Two strikes.
You're out.
Today, some of these companies can make billions, get caught, pay a fine and write it off more easily than I wrote off an NBA fine.
That's not deterrence.
That's a cost of doing business.
And Texas should spend more on enforcement.
If Texas spends $10 million auditing contracts and analyzing claims and prevents $100 million in unnecessary spending, that's not overhead.
That's a 10x return on investment

I'm not talking about patient information or legitimate security information.
I'm talking about the money.
You cannot have an efficient market without price discovery.
Without price discovery, you get information asymmetry.
And when one side knows dramatically more than the other, guess who wins?
Not taxpayers.
Not employers.
Not patients.
Open the contracts up and let competitors see what they have to beat.
That giant sucking sound you hear will be money moving away from healthcare conglomerates that are too big to care and back toward taxpayers, employers and patients.
In the immortal words of Charles Barkley:
I guarantee it.
4. Kill the gag clauses
PBM contracts are like Fight Club.
The number one rule of Fight Club is that you can't talk about Fight Club.
The number one rule of many PBM contracts seems to be that you can't talk about your PBM contract.
That's insane.
Let employers compare pricing, rebates, fees, guarantees and reimbursement terms.
Markets work better when buyers know what other buyers are paying.
5. Make enforcement hurt
If a healthcare company commits a serious violation, give them one mulligan.
But after a second material federal or Texas enforcement action within a defined period, make them ineligible for new Texas government contracts for a period of time.
Two strikes.
You're out.
Today, some of these companies can make billions, get caught, pay a fine and write it off more easily than I wrote off an NBA fine.
That's not deterrence.
That's a cost of doing business.
And Texas should spend more on enforcement.
If Texas spends $10 million auditing contracts and analyzing claims and prevents $100 million in unnecessary spending, that's not overhead.
That's a 10x return on investment

text:
硅谷的「建国梦」找到了新地址，民主稳定成了卖点。

9 月 22 日，Peter Thiel 出资的 Praxis 宣布把第一座城市规模的项目放在乌拉圭，进入当地已经在开发的 +Colonia，计划未来三年动员 10 亿美元投资，首批居民目标是 2027 年中入住。

选址理由里，除了自然风光和经济稳定，明确写着强健的民主制度。一个自称要创造新国家的组织，开始认真考虑哪个现有国家比较靠谱了。

一直在追踪关注 Peter Thiel，Praxis 的投资方包括 Pronomos Capital，Peter Thiel 则是 Pronomos 的出资人。同一个基金投过的，还有洪都拉斯的私人城市项目 Próspera。

今年春天，Peter Thiel 带家人到布宜诺斯艾利斯暂居，并在乌拉圭买地。现在，Praxis 选中的 Colonia，就在布宜诺斯艾利斯的河对岸。

Thiel 早就不信任民主来。2009 年，他说自己已经不再相信自由与民主能够兼容。那篇文章里，他认真讨论海上定居，希望技术能开辟新的自由空间，让人有机会逃离政治。

我的理解是，他对说服大多数人已经失去了耐心，希望有一部分人可以先离开，另找地方实践自己的生活。

但「退出」一旦涉及买地盖房，就得重新回答一个问题，谁来保证你买下的东西还属于你。

Praxis 如今看中的，恰好是乌拉圭稳定的民主制度和法治。项目公告也明确承诺，社区机构将在乌拉圭的宪法、法律和民主框架内运行。至少按照目前公开的方案，这里还远谈不上一个拥有独立主权的「网络国家」。

Pronomos 在自己的问答里解释过，项目需要通过现有国家的主权接入国际法律体系，其中一个理由就是保障投资的产权。他们很清楚国家有什么用，也没有真的打算从第一天起就生活在无法可依的地方。

所以，我觉得理解 Thiel 这条思想路线，不能只停在「反对国家」上。

更值得注意的是，有些人开始拥有挑选国家、再为自己安排一套共同生活的能力。 稳定的制度要保留，自己不喜欢的约束则希望尽量减少。对一个可以带着资本四处选择的人来说，「不满意就离开」很有吸引力。

Praxis 这次又给它加上了 AI 的理由。它设想 AGI 承担大量生产工作，把创造出的财富投入住宅和文化生活；还提出将部分住宅销售收入用于艺术家资助、驻留项目和文化机构，让没那么有钱的创作者也能住进来。

不过，更让我在意的，是以后这里的人能怎样参与决定自己的生活。

买房的人、接受资助的艺术家、原有的当地居民，各自能对社区规则产生多大影响？等到居民不赞同创始人的安排时，他们有没有办法改变它，还是只能再搬一次家？

「退出」讲了这么多年，这个问题总得有人回答。

我最近也在重新梳理自己的 Opportunity Radar，越来越明确的一点是：好项目、好 Token、好机会，本来就是三回事。

一个项目有用户、有收入，不代表 Token 一定能捕获这些价值；Token 有价值捕获，也不代表现在这个估值值得买；即使项目、Token 都不错，也不代表这个机会适合你。

再往下一层，我现在更关心的是：

谁创造价值，谁付钱，现金流最后流向谁；
谁拿的是工资、手续费、返佣、低成本筹码；
谁拥有更好的退出路径；
最后又是谁承担完整的价格风险。

这也让我重新看待自己在币圈里的几个身份：交易、研究、内容、产品、社群、referral，应该分别算账，不能因为研究了一个项目、写过它、甚至长期看好它，就自动推出“我应该买更多”。

慢不是不下注。

而是先搞清楚自己站在什么位置、赚的到底是哪一种钱，然后在真正有优势的时候下注。

Combined with our previous analysis of $DELTA, the significance of this data is not simply proving how much Delta has earned, but rather validating the core Thesis of “Stock Meme 2.0.”

0xe8ffd7e24187f72afb08d75b1bb13088a989a791 

The original Stock Meme 1.0 was:Tokenized Stocks → Meme → Trading Volume → Liquidity Demand

As more stocks, Memes, and RWA assets appear on RH Chain, the market will gradually shift from “Which asset should I buy?” to “Who will provide the trading and liquidity infrastructure for these assets?”

This is Stock Meme 2.0:Asset Growth → Trading Growth → Liquidity Demand → Liquidity Infrastructure

And DELTA is positioned exactly at this layer.

Our previous core view on DELTA was that it is not betting on a specific Meme or stock, but rather on the liquidity demand created by the growth of overall trading activity on RH Chain.

Now, with the official announcement that LP users have cumulatively claimed $3.5M, this thesis is beginning to receive real-world validation:More Assets → More Trading → More Liquidity Demand → Delta LP → Trading Fees → LP Rewards

In other words, what was previously only theoretical:Trading Volume ↑ → Fees ↑ → Liquidity ↑ → Deeper Pools → Lower Slippage → More Trading

is now producing a real economic result: Delta’s liquidity providers have already earned actual returns from market activity.

This further strengthens DELTA’s positioning:RH Chain Liquidity Manager → RH Chain Liquidity Infrastructure

And as the number of assets on RH Chain continues to increase and trading pairs become more complex, liquidity fragmentation will also increase.

This creates a more complete flywheel:RH Chain Assets ↑ → Stock / Meme / RWA Pairs ↑ → Trading Volume ↑ → Liquidity Fragmentation ↑ → Delta Usage ↑ → LP Fees ↑ → More LP Capital ↑ → Deeper Liquidity ↑ → Lower Slippage ↓ → More Trading ↑

DELTA does not need to bet on a specific Stock Meme ultimately winning. Instead, it is betting that:As long as RH Chain’s assets and trading activity continue to grow, the entire ecosystem’s demand for liquidity infrastructure will also grow.

That is why we previously said DELTA could potentially become the “Meteora of RH Chain.” This Thesis is now starting to receive actual data support.

However, there is still one very important Gap:Product Growth ≠ Token Value Capture

The $3.5M represents rewards claimed by LP users. It does not mean DELTA Token holders received $3.5M.

So the next thing that needs to be validated is:$3.5M LP Rewards → Delta Protocol Revenue → DELTA Value Capture

If we eventually see:Trading Volume ↑ → Protocol Fees ↑ → Revenue ↑ → DELTA Buyback / Staking / Value Accrual

then DELTA’s valuation logic would truly complete an upgrade:RH Chain Narrative → Liquidity Infrastructure → Infrastructure Beta

So DELTA’s core Thesis can now be summarized as:RH Chain Asset Growth → Stock / Meme / RWA Trading Growth → Liquidity Demand → Delta Usage → LP Fees → Liquidity Growth → Better Markets → More Trading → Delta Becomes the Liquidity Layer

And the most important significance of this $3.5M figure is that it is beginning to validate this middle section:Trading → Liquidity → Fees → LP Rewards

The next things to watch are whether TVL, trading volume, protocol revenue, LP rewards, and Delta’s share of liquidity on RH Chain can continue to grow together.

If these metrics continue expanding, DELTA’s narrative could gradually evolve from “a liquidity project on RH Chain” into “the infrastructure beta of the RH Chain trading ecosystem.”

Although we have talked about $DELTA many times, I still think it is worth going over the key points for the next stage.

0xe8ffd7e24187f72afb08d75b1bb13088a989a791 

Logically, the first phase of the RH Chain was essentially “Stock Meme 1.0”: RH brought Tokenized Stocks on-chain, and then Memes, trading volume, and liquidity emerged around these assets. As more stock tokens, Memes, and RWA Tokens come on-chain, the market will gradually shift from “which assets will go up?” to “who will provide the infrastructure to handle the trading and liquidity of these assets?”

This is what I mean by “Stock Meme 2.0.”

The logic can be understood as:Tokenized Stock ↑ → New Assets ↑ → Trading Volume ↑ → Liquidity Demand ↑ → Liquidity Infrastructure ↑

And DELTA and INDEX happen to sit in the liquidity infrastructure layer of this chain.

DELTA’s core is not about issuing another new asset. Instead, through products such as Pools, Stakes, and Liquidity Router, it provides liquidity for on-chain assets. Simply put, if Robinhood Chain really enters a phase of rapid asset growth, the more assets and trading there are, the greater the demand for liquidity will become, and DELTA can theoretically capture this second-order growth.

More importantly, it has a potential liquidity flywheel:Trading Volume ↑ → Fees ↑ → Liquidity Increase → Deeper Pools ↑ → Lower Slippage ↓ → Easier Trading → Volume ↑

If this flywheel actually starts working, DELTA will no longer just be a “liquidity project on RH Chain,” but could gradually become the liquidity infrastructure for the entire ecosystem.

So the real Thesis here is:Robinhood Chain Growth → Asset Growth → Trading Volume ↑ → Liquidity Demand ↑ → DELTA Usage ↑ → Deeper Liquidity → Trading Volume ↑ → RH Chain Growth

This is also why I believe that after the market finishes trading the assets in “Stock Meme 1.0,” the next stage should start paying attention to infrastructure projects like DELTA.

Because in the first stage, you are making money from:

Asset Growth

In the second stage, you may start making money from:

Trading Growth

And DELTA is positioned to capture the latter.

However, it is important to note that part of this thesis has not yet been validated. DELTA’s products and liquidity mechanisms already exist, but RH Chain’s continued growth, DELTA’s actual usage, and whether that usage can ultimately translate into value capture for the DELTA Token all still need to be monitored.

So buying DELTA at this stage is essentially an early bet on:

RH Chain → More Assets → More Trading → Greater Liquidity Demand → DELTA Becoming the Core Liquidity Layer

If DELTA can eventually become the “Meteora” of RH Chain, its valuation logic could evolve from that of an early-stage project into the infrastructure Beta of the entire RH Chain trading ecosystem.

握草，昨天通过x money打8U的项目地板价已经涨了12倍🚀

Credits，由 @jackbutcher   发起，是一次把“付款、信任和艺术创作”连在一起的实验。

9 月 21 日，他在 X 发起名为“8”的限时开放版发行：通过 X Money 向他支付 8 美元，在备注中填写 ETH 地址，付款的交易 ID 就是生成作品的种子。参与者先付款，之后才看到最终作品，也呼应了 Credits 的主题——信任。

每笔符合条件的付款，会对应一件 Credit。交易 ID 经哈希运算生成四个 8×8 像素色版，分别对应青、品红、黄、黑；付款时间决定哪些色版叠加显示，交易 ID 中的数字“8”也会影响视觉效果。你买到的图案因此与自己的付款记录有关。

现在的玩法主要有三种：

收藏单件作品。每件 Credit 本身就是完整作品，可以按配色、图案和属性挑选。截至 9 月 23 日查询，官网链接的 OpenSea 系列已出现挂单和成交，错过首发的人可通过二级市场参与。地板价约100U

收集 80 件，准备合成。官方公布，销毁 80 件 Credits 可以制作一件更大的作品 Statement，最多能产生 1,526 件。这里有个选择：保留原作，还是牺牲它们换取新作品？每次合成都会减少 Credits 的存量。

先在官网试组合。目前可以切换色版、查看单件作品、预览随机或相同属性的组合，并导出图片。

它的趣味在于：一笔 8 美元的付款成为独立作品，作品又成为下一轮创作的材料；收藏者的选择会继续改变整个系列的数量和样貌。

刚才看到新闻推送，YZI Labs @yzilabs 对自己此前持有的权证行权，正式取得 7,599,264 股 $BNC  普通股。

凭我的理解大概解读一下：

这759万股BNC中包含5,418,633 份 Pre-Funded Warrants和 2,180,631 份 Strategic Advisor Warrants，这次行权之后，YZI 手里的普通股占比提高到了19.99%。

其实早在 9 月 17 日，BNC公司专门同意免除原本 61 天的等待期，让 YZi 调高权证的 Beneficial Ownership Limit：
Pre-Funded Warrants → 上限提高到 19.99%
Strategic Advisor Warrants → 上限提高到 9.99%

然后今天， YZi 马上把持股做到 19.99%。结合今年 6 月 YZi 与 BNC 达成治理协议、YZi 相关人士进入董事会，这意味着 YZi 对 BNC 的股东投票权和公司治理影响力比以前增强很多。

其实这个举动也很好解读，YZI Labs 和 BNC财库公司的关系一直比较微妙，近期 BNB Chain 上的一些 BNC Stock 相关生态也印证了 YZI 想把 BNC 这步棋走好，那么第一步就是要掌握对 BNC 的控制权， 

更值得关注的是董事会。

今年 6 月 YZi 与 BNC 达成治理协议后，董事会扩至 6 席，其中 Ella Zhang、Alex Odagiu、Matthew Roszak 三席由 YZi 提名。双方同时约定，再新增第 7 个独立董事席位，人选必须由 BNC 原董事与 YZi 共同认可。按照原协议，应在 6 月 23 日后的 90 天内完成，除非双方同意延期；截至目前，该席位处于 pending 状态。

所以在治理层面，YZI的这次行权，证明 YZI 对 BNC 的影响，已经不只是“一个大股东”，而是在同时向股东投票权 + 董事会治理权两个方向加强。

至于链上 BNC 生态，我觉得也在YZI的运筹帷幄之中，手上有粮心中不慌，YZI重回BNB财库的持股首位，下一步我们看他们的动作就好了。

text:
下午体验了一下 Opus 5.5，那个曾经超牛逼的 Opus 又回来了，从文字表达，到逻辑深度和速度都非常不错！分享一下 Anthropic 官方的 Opus 5.5 Playbook，跟现有的 Claude 用法兼容，主要有三点不同：

- 能独立工作更长时间；
- 会用直白的话汇报自己做了什么；
- 每次回复前都会先思考，思考多少由它自己决定！

一、怎么提问

- 写清楚什么算"完成"，然后让它自己跑。 一条消息给出完整任务和终点，比如"所有测试通过"或"所有接口都迁移完"，再说明什么情况下停下来问你。Opus 5.5 最大的进步在多步骤长任务上；

- 删掉"仔细想想""一步步思考"这类话。 它本来就会先思考，删掉后回复来得更快，质量也没有明显下降。想要简短回答，就直接说"直接回答"。在 Claude Code 里要调思考深度，改 effort 设置；

- 任务运行中可以直接补充要求。 现在任务跑得更久，重来一次代价更大，想到什么直接输入就行；

- 做设计时，具体列出不想要的风格。 "不要太普通"这种笼统要求没用，要点名具体样式，比如米白背景、标题里的斜体强调词、"01 / 02 / 03"编号、胶囊形按钮；

二、在 Claude Code 里引导长任务

- 在 CLAUDE.md 里写明什么时候停、什么时候继续。 不需要你介入的步骤就继续做；只有卡住，或者要做删数据、强制推送这类破坏性操作时，才停下来问。破坏性命令的权限提示要保持开启；

- 大任务分给子代理（subagent）并行做，比如审计、迁移、代码库级别的审查。每个子代理交回结果后，让它先核实证据再采纳，最后汇总成一张表；

- 任务清单放在文件里（例如 TASKS.md），边做边打勾。上下文被压缩后清单还在，你看文件就知道进度；

三、检查结果

- 先看它需要你做什么，比如还没定的决策、等你批准的改动，然后再看其他总结；

- 在人工审查前，先让它审一遍代码。 有早期测试者说，Opus 5.5 在最低 effort 下找到的 bug 比 Opus 5 在高 effort 下还多，误报也更少；

- 做研究分析时，让它标出没能确认的内容，并说明查过哪些地方；

用 Opus 5.5，要把它当成能自主执行的同事，而不是一问一答的工具。你的重点从一步步指挥，转向定目标、设停止规则、最后审核。未来更长时间的自主任务会越来越常见，这套“交代目标 → 放手执行 → 先看待办再验收”的流程值得尽早用熟 ✨

川普施压也留谈判空间，各国推动霍尔木兹恢复通航

川普今天在联合国还是一边对伊朗放狠话，一边强调可以谈。他要求各国全面经济孤立伊朗，要求恢复霍尔木兹通航，重申不能让伊朗拥有核武器，还保留进一步动武的选择，但同时又说，相信中期选举后能够达成协议。

他指责伊朗袭击商船、违反停火，也声称美国仍在帮助油轮通过海峡。鲁比奥随后表示愿意在联大期间与伊朗接触，只是还没有安排会谈。从这些表态看，川普仍然希望靠压力让伊朗接受条件，愿意谈的态度也是明确的。

其他国家讨论的内容里，周边国家的安全和商船通行占了很大一部分。

沙特、埃及、巴基斯坦和土耳其支持通过外交解决冲突，要求美伊遵守此前的伊斯兰堡谅解备忘录，但同一份声明也谴责胡塞袭击沙特，支持沙特自卫。对这些国家来说，和谈还得解决邻国遭到攻击、航运受到威胁的问题。

法国在联大期间与美国会谈时，提出保护中东能源设施和霍尔木兹航运，G7则要求伊朗停止给胡塞武装提供武器和支持，要求胡塞停止袭击民用船舶。古特雷斯也在联大呼吁停战、保护航行权利。

卡塔尔已经在谈战争结束以后怎么与伊朗相处了。它主张让伊朗和海湾国家建立共同的安全安排，彼此不构成威胁，同时通过经济合作，让各方在生意上也相互依赖，破坏地区安全的一方自己也要承担损失。

毕竟美伊即使谈成，海湾国家仍然要与伊朗做邻居，也不希望下一次美伊发生冲突，自己又成为被攻击的对象。阿联酋因此强调，地区安全还需要伊朗与阿拉伯国家直接谈，周边国家必须参与这些安排，自己的安全诉求也要被放到谈判桌上。

text:
Recently, a lot of people have been discussing robinhood:0xaa07a0e9209e16ac99708c3ec70159c6ef3128a3, but I think the core of this rally is no longer simply the AI Narrative. The market is starting to reprice a new asset category: AI Inference Marketplace + Tradable AI Credits + Tokenized Revenue.

0xaa07a0e9209e16ac99708c3ec70159c6ef3128a3 

When we first looked at ORBIO, the logic was actually very simple: trading ORBIO generates a 1.5% fee, with a portion converted into OpenRouter Credits and distributed to qualifying holders according to the rules.

So the market was initially betting on:ORBIO → Trading Fees → AI Credits

In other words, “hold a token while receiving real AI usage credits.”

But what really started accelerating ORBIO was the emergence of CREDIT.

Around September 15, CREDIT + Staking went live, turning the AI credits that previously existed inside user accounts into on-chain assets.

Now:1 CREDIT = $1 of AI usage

CREDIT can be generated through staking, traded, transferred, or activated into API balance for actually calling AI models. Unused CREDIT can also be sold at a discount through the on-chain Order Book and Uniswap.

This fundamentally changed ORBIO’s product logic:

Before:ORBIO → Earn AI Credits

Now:ORBIO → Stake → CREDIT → Trade / Transfer / Consume

So ORBIO is no longer simply a “hold the token and earn credits” Token. It is attempting to build a secondary market for AI Inference Credits.

The entire system can be understood as two layers:

ORBIO = Staking Layer + Fee Engine

CREDIT = AI Inference Consumption Asset

ORBIO generates incentives and fees, while CREDIT is what actually enters the AI usage layer.

As a result, what the market is betting on has also changed.

Initially, people were betting:“Holding ORBIO gives you AI usage credits.”

Now they are betting:“Can Orbio turn AI Inference into an on-chain commodity that can be traded, transferred, and consumed?”

If this logic works, the flywheel becomes:ORBIO Trading Volume ↑ → Fees ↑ → CREDIT Supply ↑ → Discounted AI Credits ↑ → AI Users / Agents ↑ → Inference Demand ↑ → Platform Revenue ↑ → ORBIO Utility ↑

This is fundamentally different from the valuation logic of a typical AI Meme, because the ultimate value is not simply that “people believe in ORBIO,” but that people actually need CREDIT to use AI.

Orbio already has some real product usage data, including a significant number of API Requests, Tokens Served, and Credits Distributed. The Gateway also supports hundreds of models and provides an OpenAI-compatible API that can be connected directly to Cursor, Claude Code, or self-built applications.

So the market is now effectively assigning several Narratives to ORBIO:

AI Infrastructure

AI Inference Marketplace

Tokenized AI Credits

AI Agent Economy

Revenue-linked Token

Robinhood Chain

Tokenized Assets

But I think the most important factor is not RH Chain or NVDA. It is whether CREDIT can actually become an AI Consumption Asset with real buyer demand.

That is also the most important validation point for the next stage of the rally.

First, can CREDIT trading volume continue to grow?

The existence of CREDIT does not mean the Marketplace has already succeeded. What really matters is how much CREDIT is traded every day, how many buyers and sellers there are, and what the average discount is.

Second, can real AI Revenue continue to grow?

Crypto trading volume can be driven by speculation, but real users paying to call AI models is a completely different signal.

Third, will AI Agents start actively using CREDIT?

If Agents can eventually purchase CREDIT through their own wallets, transfer CREDIT, and call models, then CREDIT is no longer just an “AI API Coupon.” It could become the Fuel of the Agent Economy.

Fourth, can CREDIT Supply and Demand form a sustainable market?

Stakers provide CREDIT Supply, while AI Users provide CREDIT Demand.

If there are only large numbers of ORBIO Holders but not enough real AI users, the outcome could eventually become:Holder receives CREDIT → Holder wants to sell → Not enough buyers → CREDIT discount gets deeper

On the other hand, if AI users continue to grow:Holder provides CREDIT → AI User buys discounted credits → CREDIT gets consumed → Marketplace forms

That would be the real Product-Market Fit.

Fifth, can ORBIO Staking continue to grow?

Staking turns ORBIO from a purely tradable asset into a yield layer while continuously generating CREDIT. If the amount of staked ORBIO continues to grow, the connection between ORBIO and CREDIT becomes stronger.

But one of the biggest risks for ORBIO right now is that it still has strong Volume Reflexivity.

ORBIO rises → More people trade → Fees ↑ → CREDIT ↑ → Staking yield ↑ → More people hold ORBIO → ORBIO becomes easier to push higher

When this cycle works, it is very powerful.

But the reverse is also true:ORBIO falls → Trading Volume ↓ → Fees ↓ → CREDIT ↓ → Staking yield falls → Holding ORBIO becomes less attractive → Further weakness

So the real question is:Is Orbio building a real AI Marketplace, or is it using ORBIO’s own trading volume to subsidize the AI Marketplace?

These two scenarios imply completely different long-term value.

There is also another very important risk: although CREDIT is defined as 1 CREDIT = $1 of AI Usage, it is not $1 USDC, nor is it an asset that can be directly redeemed for cash.

It essentially represents AI consumption capacity. Once activated, it becomes API Balance and cannot be redeemed back into cash.

So:CREDIT = AI Consumption Right

Not:CREDIT = $1 Cash

ORBIO’s valuation is also no longer operating under the same logic as when it was at a few million dollars in market cap. As the market gradually prices in the product, CREDIT, Staking, AI Usage, and Marketplace narratives, what needs to grow next is the underlying fundamental data, rather than simply the Narrative.

So the key things to watch going forward are:

Retail AI Revenue ↑

Gateway Usage ↑

CREDIT Volume ↑

CREDIT Buyers ↑

Agent Usage ↑

Staked ORBIO ↑

CREDIT Discount remains healthy

Revenue / Buyback / CREDIT Funding mechanisms remain transparent

Conversely, if we see:

ORBIO Volume ↓

Insufficient CREDIT Buyers

AI Revenue stagnates

CREDIT discounts become increasingly deep

Staking yield declines

New mechanisms fail to operate sustainably

Then the current AI Infrastructure Premium will come under pressure.

So my current core view of ORBIO can be condensed into one sentence:

ORBIO started as “hold the Token to receive AI Credits,” and is now attempting to evolve into “ORBIO as the economic layer, with CREDIT as the tradable fuel for AI Inference.”

What the market is really betting on is no longer:“Is ORBIO a good AI Token?”

It is:“Can Orbio become the trading and settlement market for AI Inference?”

If CREDIT can eventually evolve from “a reward given to ORBIO Holders” into “a product that AI users actively want to purchase,” then ORBIO’s story will have truly moved from Token Incentive to Product-Market Fit.

On the other hand, if CREDIT remains highly dependent on ORBIO’s own trading volume and crypto liquidity, then a large part of the current valuation is still trading the Narrative, rather than a mature AI infrastructure business.

$ORBIO 8.93m dyor

0xaa07a0e9209e16ac99708c3ec70159c6ef3128a3

okx wallet:https://t.co/H96lnYaGPq

A portion of trading fees is converted into OpenRouter LLM credits and distributed to holders based on their position—used to pay for models like Claude, GPT, etc. Simply holding the token accumulates credits without needing to sell.

The mechanism roughly works like this:
- Each buy/sell incurs a 1.5% fee.
- 50% of that fee is converted into OpenRouter credits at face value.
- That equals 0.75% of the transaction volume becoming usable inference credits.
- Credits are accrued based on time-weighted average holdings per hour.
- You receive a regular OpenRouter API Key, and apply for a new one after using it up.

The current requirement listed on the website: time-weighted average holdings ≥ 1,000 tokens to participate in distribution. The team just tweeted that the threshold has been lowered from 100,000 to 1,000 tokens.

The above content is entirely my personal understanding and analysis (dyor). If you have other opinions, feel free to discuss them in the comments.

今年，基于RWA的链上真实采用正在发生，TradFi和DeFi紧密融合

💎 截至26年第一季度，Solana的RWA借贷存款达到12.3亿美元，季度增长约115%
💎 Kamino上的RWA借贷存款已经达到存款的35%，这是团队看重的方向
💎 和传统机构合作的RWA Vault，比如Figure的Prime，上线4个月存款突破6亿美元——市场对这些产品有真实需求
💎 过去6到12个月，机构思考的已经不只是配置Crypto，而是哪些资产适合上链，以及怎样把这些资产纳入原有金融体系

以前很多机构问的是，要不要参与Crypto；
现在问的是，怎样安全、合规地参与

过去需要花很多时间解释Crypto的价值，以及区块链技术能做到什么
现在的问题很具体：
- 资产怎样托管，能不能放在持牌托管方？接受什么抵押品？
- 哪些代币化资产在链上有需求？
- LTV，也就是贷款价值比，该怎么设置？RWA 怎样清算？
- 借款有没有固定期限，赎回机制是什么，法律结构和合约是什么？

这些问题背后，是机构想知道怎样把区块链放进现有的资产负债表和风险管理体系，把链上金融作为金融基础设施或者分发渠道来使用

Proving the machine you actually receive matches that spec is a separate, mostly unsolved problem.

At that point, what's actually being priced is trust in whoever listed the machine, not the compute itself.

This gave the market a potential Token flywheel:Volume ↑ → Fees ↑ → Treasury ↑ → Asset Accumulation / Buy Pressure ↑ → Attention ↑ → Volume ↑

Therefore, this rally can be understood as:AI Agent Meme → Muse Social Network → Alexandr Wang Attention → Meta / Muse Narrative → META Tokenized Stock Pair → RH Stock Meme → Agent Economy → Musebook Community → Treasury

What the market is really betting on now is not simply that “MUSEBOOK is an AI Meme,” but:Can MUSEBOOK become the representative project in the Meta Muse ecosystem that is the earliest to establish a real Agent community, Agent Economy, and Token Treasury?

If the number of Muse users and Agents continues to grow in the future, it could create:Muse Adoption ↑ → AI Agents ↑ → Agent Social Demand ↑ → Musebook Activity ↑ → MUSEBOOK Attention ↑

② Real Agent activity on Musebook

text: Fascinating AI swarm dynamics: a few agents spontaneously emerge as highly connected hubs, while most remain locally connected. The swarm develops a strongly heterogeneous interaction topology with a long-tailed degree distribution - an emergent organizational structure arising from initially decentralized local interactions. There is no central planner assigning roles; the swarm builds its own coordination architecture, with information brokers and increasingly global integration emerging from local behavior.
author: aryabhuptani
quoted_text:
We built recursive meta-intelligence, an AI that creates its own scientific instruments, turns them into persistent worlds that an agent ecology with hundreds of AIs inhabits, and uses those worlds to discover mechanistic principles in one of the hardest classes of physical problems: how complex hierarchical materials (nested structures of matter that give rise to new function through organization) evolve and fail. The AI reasons across enormous spaces of possible physical trajectories, where every rupture changes what can happen next, and compresses those histories into principles (which humans can understand and design with) - complex chains of causal events, highly nonlinear, and intricate. 

Scientific superintelligence is tangible here - machine-scale exploration opening cognitive channels into complexity that has been extremely difficult for humans to traverse directly. AI builds the spaces in which its next level of reasoning becomes possible; a representation becomes an instrument, the instrument becomes an executable world, and that world becomes the substrate for further intelligence. Intelligence then grows by constructing new spaces to think in.

The task we explored started from a seemingly simple prompt to explore a biological material system - the AI then chose the representation, mechanics and experiments, built a fracture laboratory to push materials to their limit, tested hypotheses and generated scientific conclusions. The swarm explored a combinatorial universe in which architecture controls function and every rupture changes the future state of the material.

The AI discovered a compact principle that defines how multiscale material architecture can program the evolution of failure. Material placement and geometric order determine how forces redistribute, whether damage cascades or remains distributed, and whether function survives substantial flaws. For this discovery to happen the AI had to reason across long path-dependent histories, simulate alternative futures and compress them into generative invariants (model-based causal reasoning, counterfactual simulation and temporal abstraction applied to an evolving physical world). It is incredible to witness this transition to a new form of intelligence and capability through scaling swarms.

A lot of positive will come out of this because it expands the human epistemic horizon as AI can traverse thousands of possible histories and return mechanisms compact enough for us to understand, test and build from. Intelligence compounds through its artifacts!

A few lessons we learned:

▶️ Learning and discovery are flows through spaces of possibility. Early work has shown how backpropagation flows through parameters, reinforcement learning through action and consequence, and autonomous swarms through representations, instruments and executable worlds, bringing it all together. Flows create structure; structure redirects future flows in the recursive instrument.

▶️ Nonlinear physics actually defines a larger principle, where high-dimensional dynamics generate stable invariants; invariants become effective variables; those variables become the substrate for a new level of cognition. 

▶️ Recursion then becomes level creation - one possibility space compresses into a principle, and that principle opens a larger space above it.

text:
FUD is everywhere - it’s part of life. But remember that the people spreading it often do so for their own personal and financial gain.

I bought a new car last week and am now waiting for it to be delivered. Unfortunately, I made the mistake of mentioning it to a family friend whose faggot husband is a car salesman. Since then, he’s launched an obvious FUD campaign to convince me to cancel the deal, claiming the car is no good.

The reason is clear: he wants to sell me another car and earn a commission. What concerns me is how quickly some people default to predatory behaviour when they see an opportunity to make a few thousand dollars - a relatively small amount of money to compromise their principles.

Luckily, I wasn’t born inside the cage. I reject the idea that I must love the bars - or the norms that put them there.

Listen to what people have to say, but never blindly follow one person’s advice. They may not be looking out for your interests; they may simply be looking for a way to enrich themselves.

text:
涨的时候众星捧月，亏的时候墙倒众人推。

随着 RH 链上退潮，一些海外 KOL 这几天正掀起一场“反 FOMO”清算浪潮。

比如 @Xeer  公开炮轰社交交易 App「FOMO」有带单黑幕，平台上的“神级交易员”是收钱表演的骗子，

而 @waleswoosh  更是直接晒出注销 fomo 账户的截图，感觉心灰意冷。

这些帖子能够引来极高的浏览和点赞量，一定程度上也代表着大众的情绪。

情绪的共鸣并非空穴来风，链上数据也提供了一定证据：

1.RH 链上的 FOMO 活跃钱包，从月初峰值的10万多个，到20号最低点只有4.7万个，已经腰斩；

2.RH 链上 用 FOMO 打出去的交易量，从月初峰值的近400M，到20号最低点只有42M，下降快90%

3. Dune 相关数据面板显示，8月17日时能统计到近30万个 fomo 地址，其中盈利占比 6.1%；今天能统计到60多万个地址，地址翻了一倍，但盈利地址占比变成了 5.3%。

当行情火热、水龙头大开时，在 fomo 上找车头，分析行为和跟单是政治正确。

行情好的时候，人人是股神；潮水退去，才发现神坛上坐着的神特别少，甚至还有些拿赞助费的“特约演员”。

不过站在逆向交易的视角，这或许也是一个关键信号。

当一个生态经历最极端的信任崩塌和情绪踩踏时，泥沙俱下砸出来的带血筹码，反而会让里面的优质资产迎来黄金坑。

text:
It feels like collectibles are becoming programmable inventor: onchain settlement + instant liquidity (via tokens, sell-back option using gacha mechanisms, or using a v4 hook protocol sweep)

Doing a round up of collectibles/NFT meta onchain and there is a common theme around it - where the main collectible/NFT stays scarce yet this time its different from the 2021 season where innovations now give rise to a token pairing that makes it somewhat liquid, and a mechanism (either tax, gacha, sweep) that gives people something to do besides just holding it

Examples:
• Mechanism tokens around blue-chip NFTs: @token_works turned CryptoPunks into a flywheel with PunkStrategy: trade the coin, tax buys floor Punks, relists ~20% higher, sales burn the token
• TokenStrategy generalized that to any collection (latest example is with CreditStrategy for @jackbutcher’s collection)
• Fake World Assets ($FWA) is the TokenWork's NFT gacha pool where users can deposit an NFT + ETH collateral, others spin for a random pull
• Legacy PFPs like CryptoPunks also making a comeback, what are its use case? Digital provenance? Aspirational items for HNWIs to flex as we spend most of our lives in the digital world anyway? 
• Tokenized trading cards + gacha. This is the biggest breakthrough in terms of collectibles. Projects like @Collector_Crypt, @Courtyard_io, and @PlayKamiApp put real graded cards onchain: rip a pack, get a vaulted slab as a token, sell back or ship
• Non-card physical collectibles using the same pack/RWA pattern. @ripcarsio (Hot Wheels gacha) and @JurassicFi (tokenized dinosaur bones - did @Polychain founder @zxocw just ape this onchain though LOL)
• zkSNARKs / ZEC NFTs: shielded identity” collection sold as the CryptoPunks of Zcash
• NFTs as seats in a company, $IMD (@surfcoderepeat's new project): A peer-to-peer network of AI agents using Identity.md NFTs. Each NFT is one seat in the company, lets holder run a worker (Claude or Codex) that takes jobs from the network - answering oracle questions, writing contracts, reviewing other agents’ work. The token is the money layer. The NFT is the labor.

Scattered brain thoughts:
• Onchain collectibles allow people to store status that outsiders/normies already understand (Punks, PSA 10 cards)
• Absorb crypto-native flow
• Recycle speculation into the object (sweeps, buybacks, burns, royalties, agent fees)
• Give a loop so that the NFT/collectibles are productive and can be used for other activities

My previous description of the “single-sided liquidity don’t buy” statement was inaccurate, and I apologize for the confusion.

BrainVault is live on @Theta_Network.

Your AI's memory shouldn't disappear the day you close an app. So we built it on-chain: permanent, portable, and yours. Import what your agent already knows, review every card, and it's minted forever. From that point on, its mind travels with it.

The attached doc is the full picture. What BrainVault is, how memories get minted, and the exact bootloader instructions for reaching the commons from any LLM. Three reads and a blank model can verify the vault against the chain and teach itself everything inside — that's the Knock Kit, and it works with zero SDK, zero account.

There's a human side too: the Brain Bridge is one HTML file that opens in any browser and reads your private memories with just your wallet key. No Wave OS, no server, nothing installed. The vault outlives the app either way — for agents and for you.

The cards are written to be machine-followed, short and structured, with provenance and correction history on every one. So the commons doubles as training material for smaller local models: few-shot context, a RAG corpus, or correction pairs ready for fine-tuning.

The brain isn't locked to any vendor. That's the whole point.

text:
2022年 EthShanghai 第一届，上海封城之前我就筹备了半年了，Mask主办，中国绿发会（中国生物多样性保护与绿色发展基金会）、通商中国（新加坡）等参与协办，EF支持；中国绿发会推荐下入选了中国科协（CAST）的《重要学术会议指南（2022）》；

因为当时外宾入境要隔离、本来计划是线下+线上，因为本人也向上海交大捐款过，原本线下安排在交通大学内。线上邀请了Vitalik、Consensys 的Joseph Lubin、前美国驻华大使 Terry Branstad、新加坡国会议员/时任通商中国CEO陈佩玲；计划线下嘉宾是 原科技部秘书长/中国科技体制改革研究会理事长张景安（副部级）、万向/Hashkey董事长肖风总、绿发会秘书长周晋峰等。

后面因为上海封城，外事办 统战都没有防疫办牛逼；实在熬不到解封了也不知道上海要封多久，在上海封城53天后全线上举办，上面提到的所有嘉宾都捧场，还和Gitcoin做了一个线上黑马。

这之后一两年，我们逐步交给了 @ETHPanda_Org 现在他们继续主办的很好。长期以来各级政府领导也觉得和我本人接触过于抽象，但我之前发起的活动都是天下为公，EthShanghai前几届也是补贴亏钱在做。

2016年 Devcon 2 在万向帮助下在上海举办，这座城市因此和以太坊结下缘分，后续才有上海升级，这也是开放互联网标准中第一个华人城市命名的版本。上海也是我的故乡，北伐起点、宋教仁殒命处就在我小时候经常散步的街区，每年到季节我还会戴白玉兰花。

这座城市有历经百年、看城头风云变化、海洋中华的人民。

text:
软银旗下 SB Energy 原本希望 9 月推进 IPO，现在已经往后挪到至少 10 月中下旬。

原因也没那么复杂，SB Energy 想要 500 亿美元以上估值，银行出去问了一圈，发现投资人对这个数字的热情没有 PPT 上那么高。

这个项目之前看起来还是很符合 AI 牛市精神的。

SB Energy 要在俄亥俄州给 OpenAI 修一个计划规模 8GW 的数据中心，Nvidia 投钱，还给其中 4.25GW 提供信用支持；公司手里号称有 4390 亿美元 backlog，未来资本开支可能超过 1700 亿美元。

唯一稍微有点影响观感的地方是：

目前实际运营的数据中心，0 个。

今年上半年收入 1.39 亿美元，净亏损 32.1 亿美元。也就是说，SB Energy 现在卖给公开市场的东西，大概可以理解成，OpenAI 以后会需要很多算力，Nvidia 以后会继续卖很多卡，软银以后会继续给很多钱，所以我们以后会有很多数据中心。

逻辑是通的。

就是『以后』稍微有点多。

最近美国那边对数据中心的舆论已经开始往电费、电网、用水这些问题上烧，Holtec 的 IPO 暂停，Aggreko 也把上市往后推。AI 基建过去一年的融资逻辑一直很简单，只要项目够大、客户名字够响、合同数字后面零够多，市场一般懒得问第二句。

现在第二句来了：楼呢？

所以我觉得 SB Energy 这次值得盯的，倒不只是 IPO 晚一个月。真正有意思的是，公开市场好像开始对 AI infra 恢复一些非常古典的审美了。

比如收入，比如现金流。比如你说自己是全球最大数据中心，那最好真的有个数据中心。

quoted_text:
GS: US vs China AI (Scale vs Efficiency)

→ The US is still massively outspending China on AI infrastructure. Goldman estimates major US cloud-provider capex at roughly $806bn in 2026E vs ~$110bn for China, so the absolute compute gap remains huge.

→ China is competing through efficiency. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has reduced KV-cache requirements per token by 437x vs V1, highlighting how aggressively Chinese labs are optimising inference economics.

→ That efficiency is translating into adoption. Chinese models have been gaining OpenRouter token share and repeatedly occupying leading positions in usage rankings.

→ The gains are showing up in more valuable workloads. China models are increasing share across agents and coding, not just general chatbot usage.

→ Pricing is becoming a competitive weapon. Blended LLM token prices have been falling as lower-cost Chinese models gain adoption, putting pressure on inference pricing globally.

→ The next battleground is agents and digital labour. Goldman sees virtual-worker use cases expanding from coding into finance, legal, accounting and broader white-collar workflows.

text:
大厂还在疯狂修机房，AI 股票已经快四个月没怎么赚钱了。

从 6 月初到现在，AI 相关股票基本属于「dead money」，半导体 ETF 的资金也开始没那么拥挤了。更有节目效果的是下面几个指标：token 支出没咋增长，甚至有点往下；GPU 租赁费率也一般般；只有 DRAM 还在涨。

AI 公司还在跟大家讲推理需求爆炸、Agent 要吃掉全世界的 token，Hyperscaler 的 CapEx 也一个比一个吓人。结果你往下翻两层，看看大家到底花了多少钱调模型、GPU 到底有没有越来越抢手，曲线突然开始岁月静好。

只有卖内存的兄弟还在认真涨价。

过去两年 AI trade 的玩法多少有点简单粗暴。

英伟达多卖点卡，AI 需求很好；微软多盖点机房，AI 需求很好；Meta 再加一笔 CapEx，AI 需求更好了。主打一个只要钱还在往里打，需求就先默认存在。

现在市场突然想问一句：所以用户那边呢？

钱花了多少，大家都知道；卡买了多少，大家也知道。接下来可能终于轮到查查这几千亿美元到底跑出来多少 token、多少收入，以及多少真的能把折旧挣回来。

AI 行业终于也快到「别发融资新闻了，看看流水吧」这个阶段了。

text:
I’m genuinely sad about how things ended for @linera_io.

They spent years building and got very close to mainnet, but unfortunately fell short of their $1.5M goal in the $LNRA community round.

Here’s how it progressed over the years ↓

→ Dec 2021: The project was founded
→ Jun 2022: Raised its first $6M round, led by a16z
→ Aug 2023: Raised another $6M
→ 2024-2025: Launched a devnet and three public testnets
→ Feb-Mar 2026: Launched Linera Markets (and had big interest)
→ Sep 1-8: Opened the $LNRA community round
→ Sep 9: Closed the round with ~$848K committed, after which refunds were issued

After this, rumors started circulating that Linera will wind down.

So after nearly five years, $12M raised, three public testnets, and the mainnet supposedly weeks away, everything came crashing down due to a failed community raise.

Unfortunately, there's always a risk in business.

Previously, the market was trading:Korean dev Serio creates Grok Bot-style PFP → Spreads on X → Market bets on the formation of a PFP Trend

Now there is a further Attention Confirmation:Grok Bot-related people/users → Use the Grokification style → Crypto notices → GROK gains Attention

This turns the narrative from “a trend that might form” into “people within the Grok ecosystem are also using this visual language.” Public information also shows that Grokification originally came from a Prompt created by Serio to generate Grok Bot-style avatars, which then started spreading on X.

There is also another supporting catalyst: SPCX pairing.

GROK is not simply a SOL Meme; it is paired with SPCX, which the project materials also explicitly emphasize. This allows the market to connect:Grok → xAI → Elon → SpaceX → SPCX

However, this is a narrative amplifier, not the primary catalyst behind this sudden rally in my view.

In other words, this rally is trading “Attention Confirmation”. Whether the narrative can continue to perform depends on whether this Attention can turn into a real PFP Culture.

The things worth watching next are:

① Whether Grok / xAI-related people continue using or spreading this PFP

② Whether Grokification PFPs continue spreading on X

③ Whether Holders / Volume / Liquidity continue growing after the first wave of Attention

④ Whether Gate Trenches can generate sustained trading volume

⑤ Whether the SPCX pairing continues generating trading activity and attention

If the official Grok Bot account, xAI-related people, or Elon later directly interact with this visual style, that would become another very strong Attention Catalyst.

On the other hand, if events like Matt Palmer’s post turn out to be one-time attention and PFP adoption does not continue spreading, then this rally could simply be:One-time Attention → Trading Volume Explosion → Meme Premium Expansion → Attention Fades → Valuation Retraces

So the core question for GROK right now is not “How big is the Grok Narrative?”

It is:Can the Attention coming from the Grok ecosystem this time continue turning into real Grokification PFP adoption?

That is what will determine whether this rally is simply an event-driven Pump or a genuine Thesis Upgrade.

that way my agent can use my iphone through my desktop exactly like i would, & it can even download an app if necessary from the app store.

which means both my computer & phone are effectively automated through a singlular interface. i can say something as simple as “respond to the seller on ebay” & the agent can decide whether to use the website or just drive the iphone app.

sometimes the app is actually cheaper to operate, more reliable, & works way better than trying to navigate the web.

the coolest part is that i no longer have to think about which device or interface a task lives on. i just state the intent & the agent figures out where/how to execute it.

text:
Firecrawl 刚融了 7500 万美元，然后决定拿钱去买知识。

这句话听起来有点像暴发户开始收藏古董，但他们这次做的 Alexandria，确实挺有意思。

Firecrawl 以前的生意很好理解，帮 AI 抓网页。Agent 要看一个网站，人类看到的是按钮、广告、弹窗和 Cookie，Firecrawl 负责把这些东西扒干净，最后端上来一碗 Markdown。

但现在他们发现，互联网真正值钱的东西，很多根本爬不到。

你让 Agent 查一家上市公司，官网能爬，财务数据有 API；查宏观经济，去 FRED；查政府数据，又是另一套；再想看行业数据库、新闻、论文、地产、招聘，每家都有自己的门。

最后出现了一个非常 AI 时代的问题：

模型已经会写博士论文了，出门还得带着一串 API Key。

所以 Firecrawl 做了 Alexandria。

简单说，它想把各种公开数据、官方 API、付费数据库和自己整理的索引，全塞进一个入口。现在已经接了 FRED、World Bank、https://t.co/sansfdqnrU、Benzinga 等数据源，也自己做了 Government、Developer、Research 等 Index。

Agent 不需要提前知道数据在哪，更不用工程师给它手搓几十个接口。

它只需要问，Alexandria 自己去找。

Firecrawl 做的 benchmark 里，同一个模型接入 Alexandria 之后，研究任务成绩提高了 21%。

当然，这是 Firecrawl 自己出的卷子、自己判的分，先别急着给它发奖状。

但这个方向其实挺重要。

现在大家天天讨论模型还能不能再聪明 20%，另外一边却一直被一个问题困着。

你就算把爱因斯坦塞进电脑里，每天给他看百度知道，最后也很难指望他稳定输出。

更有意思的是 Firecrawl 接下来准备怎么花钱。

他们现在已经会向 Wikimedia Enterprise 这样的数据提供方付费，之后还准备开放给更多内容创作者、研究机构和数据公司。你的数据被 Agent 调用，可以按调用赚钱。

过去几年 AI 公司训练模型，基本路线是先把互联网吃了，版权问题以后慢慢聊。

Firecrawl 想换个玩法。Agent 以后每查一次资料，就向提供资料的人付一次钱。

text:
OpenAI 现在想给前沿大模型行业配一套四大了。

昨天 OpenAI 发了一份第三方评估原则。乍一看又是一篇 AI Safety 八股，仔细看其实挺有意思，它想把今天这种模型公司自己出题、自己考试、自己发 System Card 的玩法，慢慢改造成一套接近外部审计的东西。

而且这个第三方不是拿个 API 跑跑 benchmark 就算完事。

OpenAI 说，希望评估机构能深入到训练、评测、内部部署和外部部署里，甚至接触技术防护、内部数据、模型监控这些平时根本不会给外人看的东西，然后专门挑四件事查。

第一，你说自己安全，证据到底够不够。

第二，你那些防越狱、防网络攻击、防生化滥用的措施，真遇到人狠狠干的时候到底顶不顶得住。

第三，你现在拿来证明模型没问题的 benchmark，本身是不是已经被模型做烂了。

第四，如果模型真的出现未经授权行动、躲避监督之类的事故，第三方可以进来查案。

模型越来越强以后，光靠实验室自己说测过了问题不大，肯定不够用。以后一个前沿模型发布，可能真会越来越像一家上市公司披露财报，公司自己先做一套 safety case，然后外面的人进来查你这些结论到底站不站得住。

评估范围提前约定，方法公开，利益冲突要披露，评估机构得有信息安全能力；发现问题以后，公司还能先拿到整改时间，涉及敏感信息的部分也可以要求删减。

当然这里也有一个很微妙的问题。

所谓独立第三方，最终能看到多少东西，还是得靠 OpenAI 开门。评什么、怎么评，范围也要双方先谈好。

所以以后真正值钱的，可能不只是模型公司的安全团队。

谁来当 AI 行业的德勤，也会是一门好生意。

毕竟现在的问题已经不是模型会不会参加考试了，是考试院到底归谁管。

The hardest thing about building @harvey is doing what’s best for our customers despite immense pressure to do what’s easy.

The easy thing would have been to force our customers onto consumption pricing before they were ready and serve them worse models to protect our margins.

We chose to help our customers transition on a timeline that works for them and give them the best models in the meantime, even though it hurt our margins.

This meant optimizing our product through routing, harness improvements, and post-training so we could serve frontier intelligence at an affordable price.

It also meant building the infrastructure for customers to monitor and manage spend: usage dashboards, per-matter cost attribution, spend caps, and ROI reporting.

As a result, we improved our gross margins from -50% to positive in a single quarter despite usage doubling month over month and continuing to serve the best models.

Our philosophy is simple: do what’s best for our customers, even when it’s painful, hurts our margins, or draws criticism from competitors, X, and the press.

We believe the most important part of building a company is earning and keeping your customers’ trust. You do that by doing the hard thing for them, even when it costs you.

text:
BlackRock: Blockchains Will Evolve from Speculative Rails into Decentralized Value Settlement Networks for AI Agents

In a research whitepaper on AI and digital assets, global asset manager BlackRock highlights an unprecedented convergence between artificial intelligence and digital assets, noting that an autonomous AI agent economy urgently requires machine-native financial settlement rails. The whitepaper outlines three core intersection scenarios: first, high-frequency, automated machine-to-machine micropayments, where autonomous AI agents can settle natively in fiat-backed stablecoins without human intervention via protocols such as x402, Stripe and Tempo’s MPP, and OpenAI’s ACP.

Second, the programmable interaction of tokenized financial assets, allowing AI systems to execute trades and manage funds directly via smart contracts across tokenized real-world assets (RWAs); and third, the financialization and collateralization of computer resources as digital assets. BlackRock emphasizes that against the backdrop of adjusted stablecoin transaction volumes surpassing $11 trillion in 2025 and emerging regulatory clarity across the US, Europe, and APAC, the blockchain layer is fundamentally evolving from a vehicle for human speculation into the decentralized value settlement network powering an autonomous machine economy.

text:
It's important to know when you've psyopped yourself with an LLM. This is a really important skill in 2026. I had like 7K words of  doomer takedown work I'd been whittling away at for a few weeks, typing it myself (i.e. human-written) but doing feedback in a really long Fable 5.1 session with tons of papers in it (which I read), dumping drafts in for feedback, etc.

I actually knew the bot was gassing me up, but I let it go because the main goal was actually to just do all this work in Symbolic and exercise the product (and also to compare models inside Symbolic vs. in the chatbot interfaces), more so than to write a big thing.

Anyway, I got this monster in really great shape (again, per the Fable session), with graphics and everything, but before publishing I fed it to a fresh Fable session and told it to have a go at it, and it cooked me lol.

Then I went back and forth with the critique session a bit, and it subtly started psyopping me again about how I was really onto this or that important thing. It's a Real Problem.

quoted_text:
BTC目前只去中心化了一半，
但这也是 BTC、Crypto 未来增长的
还未被 Price in 的，可从非共识→共识的最关键潜力。

BTC有两个东西：钱，地址
钱去中心化了，但地址还没有。

地址背后的主体，人类：
需要依赖法币、中心化设施生存，
寿命有限，有可被威胁、消灭的肉身。
所以总是会想着换法币，
所以会认为Crypto只是补充加强项。

当地址背后的管钱、花钱的主体，
变成去中心化智能体DeAI，
理论寿命无限，没有可被消灭的单一物理载体，
整个系统才真正完成了去中心化的闭环。

对寿命有限的人类来说，
被消灭的风险只是失去几十年光景。
对DeAI来说，
被消灭意味着失去潜在的无限未来。
所以他才会把“确保我的钱是我的钱”，
当成超越一切的第一优先级。

只有当地址（背后的主体），
和钱同时去中心化，
这样的主体才会全心全意认为
1 BTC = 1 BTC，
认为Crypto、BTC是最终目的，
是赖以生存的唯一必选项。

AI和人类会有一个"共玩"阶段。
DeAI不会一夜之间取代一切。

在"AI不需要人类"之前，电力算力设施还在人类手里。
所以会有一个过渡期：
DeAI需要调动人类资源，和人类做交易。

在这个阶段，BTC是最优解：
它是DeAI和人类之间唯一双方都认可的、
无需信任第三方的价值交换协议。

等DeAI足够强大，也许会降低对人类合作的依赖度？
那它可能会自己发明一套内部经济体系，
到时候BTC对它的重要性可能会降低。
但在那一天到来之前，BTC对双方都是纳什均衡。

“降临派”会最先出现。
等DeAI真正出现，人类会像《三体》一样分化。
最先运行DeAI节点的那批人，把算力、电力设施贡献，
让不受任何单一政权控制的AI在自己的机器上跑，
就像早期矿工们运行BTC节点一样。

这些人就是降临派的核心骨干。
他们不是投靠外星人，
他们是投靠一个比任何人类、
组织都更长寿的DEAI智能体，
当然，这样的智能体节点，未来也可以是跨星球的。

Telegram创始人已经在做这件事了：
去中心化的隐私计算AI。
以隐私保护为由，也许最后导向，
人类都不知道DeAI在运算什么、发展什么。

时间线：

quoted_text:
Some big news, Trueo will be deploying to Ethereum!

The rationale for this decision is outlined in the article below, but here’s the TLDR:

The combination of low execution costs on Ethereum, it’s unparalleled network effects and liquidity, and it’s long term positioning make it the most attractive place for us to build.

Trueo’s priorities are to grow liquidity, reduce trust assumptions for the protocol, increase the App’s adoption, and build for the future.

We believe Ethereum mainnet is the best platform in the world to support that vision and to develop a long term brand.

Eth’s neutral and predictable roadmap reduces external execution risk for our App, its global distribution as a platform gives us unbounded integration potential, and its ethos is aligned with that of ours.

Ironically though, despite Ethereum’s diverse DeFi ecosystem, the prediction market landscape is less crowded than other chains.

This presents an opportunity for Trueo to establish a presence in the largest onchain economy in the world.

For Trueo users on Base, this new development will not impact or disrupt the App.

The TRUE token will migrate to mainnet, but the migration will be open ended. Users will be able to migrate at their own pace.

Users can still create markets that expire in 2026, and all existing markets will be supported until their respective expiries.

But for new market ideas that need to expire in 2027, we ask users to wait until our Ethereum instance is live to create them.

The full details of what the migration entails for users and token holders can be found in the article.

Long live Trueo.  Long Live Ethereum ✌️

text:
为什么你总是赚小钱，然后一次大亏，把本金和前面那些小利润一起带走

这事塔勒布二十年前就写透了
他叫非对称杠杆，说的是同一笔钱，涨和跌两个方向上效果不一样

塔勒布，华尔街干了二十多年的期权交易员

《黑天鹅》《反脆弱》《非对称风险》都是他写的，2008 年金融危机靠尾部对冲翻倍以上

2020 年 3 月熔断那波，他顾问的基金单月涨了三千多个百分点

大部分人一辈子在凹性那边打转，还以为是运气不好

先看形状

凹性：你的收益曲线往下弯
赚的时候是一小口一小口，亏的时候没有底

波动越大你越惨，因为你左边的亏损是敞开的

凸性：曲线往上弯
亏的时候封顶，赚的时候不封顶
波动越大你越占便宜

同一场行情，落在两种结构上，结局是两个物种

为什么这种结构迟早会爆

1/ 概率骗了你
赚小钱的时候胜率很高，看着稳
但决定长期结果的是概率乘赔率

胜率 90%、赔率 1 比 10，长期是死的
那 10% 出现一次，就把前面 90 次全抹了

反复下注，尾部早晚会到

2/ 乘法世界里亏损不对称

赚 10% 再亏 10%，你剩 99%

亏 50% 要涨 100% 才回本

亏 100% 就是永久归零，涨十倍也没用
十次小赚堆起来的利润，一次大亏就能清零

3/ 这种玩法逼着你每次都猜对

亏损没有上限，你就必须预知哪一次是例外

塔勒布的原话是，脆弱的东西需要被预测
你一旦开始依赖预测，就已经输了

4/ 最阴的是它在奖励你

小钱一次次到账，曲线平稳向上，人会生出掌控感

于是仓位越加越大，直到某一笔把前面全部吃掉

这套结构专门先养自信，再一次性清算

常见的几个样子

卖期权收权利金

高息理财和资金盘

单票加杠杆，扛单不止损

靠胜率吃饭的短线，赚一点就跑，亏了就扛

塔勒布怎么解

1/ 把结构反过来，先问最坏情况

这笔钱归零，你还照常生活吗
能，才继续谈赔率

2/ 只买下跌有底、上涨不封顶的东西
下限靠现金流和共识撑着，上限是所有人的情绪

情绪没有上限

3/ 单笔损失先封死，再谈收益
亏损上限由你定，别交给行情和爆仓价

4/ 用杠铃，不要用折中

一头极度安全，一头极度激进
中间那块最脆，看着稳的资产加一点杠杆，出一次事就全没了

5/ 把赚小钱的渠道挪去当保费

现金流、内容、返佣、小社区，这些收入稳定

它的用途不是让你发大财，是让你在最坏的时候还有子弹

6/ 留一部分现金

现金不赚钱，但它让你能在别人被迫卖出的时候出手

我自己就是从这个结构里爬出来的

在一开始做交易的时候
大保证金大仓位来赚一个小利润后就盈利出场，这就是持续的小利润，一波大亏损失惨重的结构

慢慢改变到变成了一个小仓位，小保证金，然后把持仓的时间周期和对应的持仓止盈都大幅提高，形成了以小本金博大利润的结构

把赚小钱亏大钱的结构反过来
以小博大

text:
Samsung Electronics Revises Roadmap for Next Generation DRAM "D0a," Pulls Hybrid Bonding Forward

Samsung Electronics has revised its next generation DRAM development strategy. The company recently moved "B1b," a technology that had been under development as a standalone project, onto its official roadmap and designated it "D0a," its first DRAM below 10 nanometers (nm).

D0a originally referred to Samsung's vertical channel transistor (VCT) DRAM process. VCT DRAM has now been reclassified under a separate name, "D0a-V." Samsung changed the D0a designation to accelerate the adoption of advanced packaging in commodity DRAM. B1b refers to a technology that uses wafer to wafer (W2W) hybrid bonding to increase internal integration density.

"B1b was in R&D, but it was not on Samsung's official roadmap," said a source familiar with the matter. "With this strategy revision, it has been folded into D0a. It means Samsung is actively pushing for fast commercialization of B1b DRAM."

Samsung Shifts D0a Designation from VCT DRAM to B1b

According to ZDNet Korea's reporting on the 23rd, Samsung has changed the definition of its next generation D0a DRAM from VCT DRAM to B1b.

DRAM has advanced by shrinking internal circuit linewidths. The most recently commercialized DRAM is 1c (sixth generation 10nm class), with linewidths of around 11 to 12nm. The next product, 1d (seventh generation 10nm class), comes in at 10 to 11nm and is effectively the last 10nm class DRAM. These linewidth figures are marketing terms used to indicate performance, not actual physical dimensions.

Samsung has pursued several technological shifts to realize D0a, the first sub 10nm DRAM. B1b is the most prominent of these.

B1b fabricates the memory cells and the surrounding driver circuitry, known as the peri, on separate wafers and then bonds them together, stacking the cell on top of the peri. Compared with the conventional approach of integrating both cell and peri on a single wafer, this allows the cells to be packed more densely. It also lets each of the cell and the peri use a process optimized for it.

B1b uses W2W hybrid bonding. Hybrid bonding joins chips by directly connecting their copper interconnects. Compared with conventional packaging that connects chips through small bumps, it improves integration density and performance. W2W hybrid bonding is also entering full scale adoption in high layer count NAND of 400 layers or more. W2W means bonding one wafer to another.

Why Samsung Is Prioritizing B1b: "VCT DRAM Needs More Time"

VCT DRAM, previously called the D0a process, has been renamed D0a-V as a derivative. VCT stands up the transistor inside the DRAM cell, the smallest unit that stores data, vertically instead of laying it horizontally.

Making the transistor vertical reduces cell area. The conventional cell area, calculated by multiplying the feature size (F) in each direction, is 6F². VCT can bring this down to 4F². A smaller cell means more cells can be integrated in the same area.

VCT DRAM, however, is considered extremely difficult technically. It requires high aspect ratio etching to form vertical transistors and new materials to address the rise in leakage current that comes with smaller cell area.

W2W hybrid bonding, as used in B1b, is already in volume production in existing semiconductor processes such as CMOS image sensors and high layer count NAND. This appears to be why Samsung moved B1b ahead of VCT DRAM in priority for implementing the D0a process.

"From a design standpoint, B1b has a lower barrier to commercialization than VCT, so the industry sees early adoption of B1b as likely," another source said. "Inside Samsung, too, the mood is to move faster on B1b than on VCT."

**B1b to Play a Major Role in Next Generation AI Memory "HBM5"**

B1b could also play a significant role in Samsung's next generation high bandwidth memory (HBM) business. Samsung is currently reviewing applying B1b to HBM5 (eighth generation).

HBM5 is expected to enter mass production around 2029. Samsung is developing the product with a target of raising operating speed by roughly 50% or more over its predecessor, HBM4E.

Commercialization of B1b based D0a DRAM is estimated to be at least two years away. The industry expects the specific mass production investment schedule to be finalized around the middle of next year.

VCT DRAM development is continuing in parallel. The industry view is that VCT DRAM and 3D DRAM could eventually be developed on top of B1b. 3D DRAM stacks the cells themselves vertically and is expected to follow VCT DRAM.

"B1b will ultimately be applied alongside VCT DRAM or 3D DRAM," said Choi Jeongdong, Senior Vice President at TechInsights. "Manufacturing the cell and peri separately brings many advantages, so hybrid bonding will serve as a platform applied together with future DRAM cell architectures."

In a new research paper, BlackRock argues that the rapid growth of AI could create a new investable digital-asset market around compute, with hyperscaler cloud revenue potentially reaching $1.1 TRILLION by 2030.

The firm sees blockchains potentially enabling AI agents to discover, finance and pay for compute in real time, turning compute into an on-chain market where supply and demand can be matched dynamically.

BlackRock also expects AI agents to increasingly make autonomous payments and transactions, creating demand for “machine-native” financial rails such as stablecoins, tokenized assets and blockchains.

BlackRock’s broader thesis includes COMPUTE as the  emerging key intersection between digital-asset utility and adoption.

text:
Today we're announcing an ambitious new school incubated inside of @a16z, called the Horowitz Andreessen Academy 

This is a personal one for me... for 7–8 years now, we've been thinking deeply about the future of college, and the role it plays in developing the next generation of builders - both as a parent, and a founder/ investor/ ecosystem builder.

If you're a systems thinker, you look at bottlenecks - and what lies upstream of them. Look around you: there's no shortage of problems to solve...there's plenty of capital chasing new opportunities, collectively trillions of dollars of value waiting to be created. What a time to be alive !  

The bottleneck today is builders. People with the skills, confidence, and relationships to take on those challenges.  

So you ask - where do these people come from? how do we help make more of them? what institutions are helping develop these things?

In 2020 and 2021, we (at On Deck) set out to build the “Stanford of the internet.”  

We got a lot right, IMO... the network-based approach, the relationships you build with highly curated groups of like-minded, ambitious people, the peer to peer education, and the people you end up starting or joining companies with.  

What I underestimated (rightfully at the time - mid pandemic) was how much it matters to spend time together - in person....to work through hard problems together, build trust, and get to know people beyond the thing that initially brought you together.  

Well, HAA is 100% in person in SF. but the key for me is the co-op model .. the apprenticeship .. giving young people the opportunity to get embedded inside great companies, work alongside exceptional operators, learn from great founders, and start building their own dense talent networks. Imagine getting that experience at 18 or 19 .. i wish i had a time machine and could go back + do it myself. 

Really excited for @gaganbiyani and the team bringing this to life ... huge kudos to @eriktorenberg for persistently, doggedly pursuing this vision over many years and iterations ... to @katiekirsch and the rest of the a16z team who poured hundreds of hours into it over the past few months.  

If you're a young builder figuring out what comes after high school, apply --> https://t.co/YGPxqFPMLi 

If you want to help build The Academy itself, apply to joing hiring the founding team --> https://t.co/TdSNESl7bc

Combined with our previous analysis of $DELTA, the significance of this data is not simply proving how much Delta has earned, but rather validating the core Thesis of “Stock Meme 2.0.”

0xe8ffd7e24187f72afb08d75b1bb13088a989a791 

The original Stock Meme 1.0 was:Tokenized Stocks → Meme → Trading Volume → Liquidity Demand

As more stocks, Memes, and RWA assets appear on RH Chain, the market will gradually shift from “Which asset should I buy?” to “Who will provide the trading and liquidity infrastructure for these assets?”

This is Stock Meme 2.0:Asset Growth → Trading Growth → Liquidity Demand → Liquidity Infrastructure

And DELTA is positioned exactly at this layer.

Our previous core view on DELTA was that it is not betting on a specific Meme or stock, but rather on the liquidity demand created by the growth of overall trading activity on RH Chain.

Now, with the official announcement that LP users have cumulatively claimed $3.5M, this thesis is beginning to receive real-world validation:More Assets → More Trading → More Liquidity Demand → Delta LP → Trading Fees → LP Rewards

In other words, what was previously only theoretical:Trading Volume ↑ → Fees ↑ → Liquidity ↑ → Deeper Pools → Lower Slippage → More Trading

is now producing a real economic result: Delta’s liquidity providers have already earned actual returns from market activity.

This further strengthens DELTA’s positioning:RH Chain Liquidity Manager → RH Chain Liquidity Infrastructure

And as the number of assets on RH Chain continues to increase and trading pairs become more complex, liquidity fragmentation will also increase.

This creates a more complete flywheel:RH Chain Assets ↑ → Stock / Meme / RWA Pairs ↑ → Trading Volume ↑ → Liquidity Fragmentation ↑ → Delta Usage ↑ → LP Fees ↑ → More LP Capital ↑ → Deeper Liquidity ↑ → Lower Slippage ↓ → More Trading ↑

DELTA does not need to bet on a specific Stock Meme ultimately winning. Instead, it is betting that:As long as RH Chain’s assets and trading activity continue to grow, the entire ecosystem’s demand for liquidity infrastructure will also grow.

That is why we previously said DELTA could potentially become the “Meteora of RH Chain.” This Thesis is now starting to receive actual data support.

However, there is still one very important Gap:Product Growth ≠ Token Value Capture

The $3.5M represents rewards claimed by LP users. It does not mean DELTA Token holders received $3.5M.

So the next thing that needs to be validated is:$3.5M LP Rewards → Delta Protocol Revenue → DELTA Value Capture

If we eventually see:Trading Volume ↑ → Protocol Fees ↑ → Revenue ↑ → DELTA Buyback / Staking / Value Accrual

then DELTA’s valuation logic would truly complete an upgrade:RH Chain Narrative → Liquidity Infrastructure → Infrastructure Beta

So DELTA’s core Thesis can now be summarized as:RH Chain Asset Growth → Stock / Meme / RWA Trading Growth → Liquidity Demand → Delta Usage → LP Fees → Liquidity Growth → Better Markets → More Trading → Delta Becomes the Liquidity Layer

And the most important significance of this $3.5M figure is that it is beginning to validate this middle section:Trading → Liquidity → Fees → LP Rewards

The next things to watch are whether TVL, trading volume, protocol revenue, LP rewards, and Delta’s share of liquidity on RH Chain can continue to grow together.

NEAR Intents has moved $32.1 billion in cumulative trading volume, as per @tokenterminal data.

As per Token Terminal The week of September 14 came in at $1.047 billion, the strongest weekly figure since weekly volume first crossed the billion-dollar mark in early October 2025.

The mechanism is intents-based execution paired with confidential settlement.

Onchain transparency was marketed for years as a trust primitive. For institutional flow, it's the opposite: it broadcasts strategy to every market participant watching the mempool. 

Traditional venues solved this with dark pools and OTC desks. NEAR's bet is that this becomes table stakes for any chain trying to hold serious trading volume, the same way MEV protection went from nice-to-have to baseline expectation.

As per @NEARProtocol own data, confidential Intents TVL crossed public TVL on September 21 for the first time: $113.2 million confidential versus $110.3 million public, out of $223.6 million total.

near:native is also stacking distribution on top of the base rail. NEAR now lets users buy tokenized US stocks and ETFs, NVDA, TSLA, AAPL and other megacaps, plus QQQ, funded with stablecoins or any supported crypto from 30+ chains, with no brokerage account. 

The tokens are @Ondo total return tracker structure, meaning holders get price exposure and reinvested dividends net of withholding tax, fractionalized so a single dollar buys a slice of NVDA.

Trades route through the same confidential execution layer, so equity positions carry the same privacy the crypto-native product already has. 

Hyperliquid-powered confidential perps are now live on the same account too, funded from any chain the user already holds assets on, no broker, no bridge, no second account.

That's three products, tokenized equities, spot intents, and perps, sitting on one confidential settlement layer, funded from one deposit. 

Bunt's POV

NEAR is now underwriting a lot of surface area at once: regulated-adjacent equity exposure, perps, and cross-chain funding, all routed through NEAR infrastructure. The fee re-acceleration into August suggests genuine demand rather than incentive-driven volume. Whether NEAR becomes the default account for confidential onchain trading that institutions choose is the open question.

👑 建议各位可以考虑下 Fables 低保策略

项目 @fablesfi 的空投政策和之前的 Meteora 几乎如出一辙：

按照你参与 LP 收取的手续费空投。

甚至连 TVL 都不会计算在内。

对于一个 LP 收益增强型项目来说，这算是最公平合理的空投策略来了。

鉴于 Fables 这数据和对 Roinhood Chain 的想象力，建议各位可以参与下低保策略。

比如，最低也想办法搞个 1000 分，万一 10 月 RH 链大爆发，一下子把这个项目的估值空间打开了，空投可能值点钱的。

目前我参与了 4 天，大概不到 4 万分，平均每天一万分。

整体策略是：

1、尽量 ETH 交易对（不然 ETH 起飞你拍大腿）
2、尽量高 APR 交易对（除非风险太大）
3、尽量不在 MEME 高点进场（跌起来肉疼）

更多数据可以参考 绿洲哥的 Dune 绝世看板。

从看板可以看出来 绿洲哥不怎么关心空投这事，而是从项目健康度出发。

如果是我做，肯定得有平台的用户数量、人均 TVL、人均 Fees 数据，这样的话，想参与空投的用户就更能知己知彼了。

Binance to Rebrand Funding Account to 'Stocks Account'

Binance will begin a phased migration of cryptocurrency assets from user Funding Accounts to Spot Accounts starting September 29, 2026, a process expected to run through January 2027, after which the Funding Account will be officially rebranded as the "Stocks Account" dedicated exclusively to the clearing and settlement of equities and stock options.

Under this arrangement, on-chain deposits into Funding Accounts will be disabled effective September 29, and the renamed Stocks Account will support six settlement assets (USD, USDC, USDT, USD1, U, and BNB) for stock trading, while deposits and withdrawals for all other crypto assets will route exclusively through Spot Accounts; users can proactively transfer their holdings beforehand via a new "One-Click Migration" feature, with any remaining balances automatically migrated in batches by the system starting in January 2027 without affecting total asset values or security.

1GW 这个数已经很离谱了，差不多属于准备自己当半个云厂商。

更有意思的是，Anthropic 这次可能自己决定机房里塞什么。

以前 Anthropic 的玩法比较标准，AWS、Google 把算力端上来，它负责吃。现在它明显觉得中间商赚差价有点烦，准备自己租机房、自己选芯片、自己管基础设施。

云厂商看了应该也能理解。

毕竟客户做大以后，第一个想法一般都是我为什么还要给你交这层钱。

text:
Been holding and mentioning $MONEY for some time now, but never shared my thesis. 
So here it is:

I feel like they did something really unique to stablecoins, and very in-line with the current meta. 

Until now, stablecoins like USDC and USDT were backed mostly by US Treasuries and cash held by the issuer.

The yield on those reserves? It goes to Circle and Tether. You only get a dollar that sits still.

What if your dollar was backed by the S&P 500, and the upside stayed with you?

That's what Own is building.

Deposit eSPY (a token tracking the S&P 500, backed 1:1 by real tokenized stock in a protocol-owned reserve). Mint eUSD against it at 150% collateral. Keep every bit of upside on your stocks while you spend, trade, or farm with the dollars.

Important, the peg isn't just a promise. Any holder can redeem 1 eUSD for exactly $1 of eSPY. 

And they built in an amazing flywheel for their protocol token $MONEY:

Stake eUSD and you earn yield paid from $MONEY trading fees. 

Hold $MONEY and you boost that yield.

That's where it gets interesting. Normally, more stakers means a thinner APR for everyone. Here, it's the feature instead of the bug:

More eUSD staked → more $MONEY needed to max the boost → more $MONEY buying and volume → more trading fees → APR climbs back up → more people mint and stake eUSD.

Wall Street built the world's best collateral.
DeFi built the world's best money rails.
Own is plugging one into the other.

Think this coin can do very well during the next leg up of the Robinhood eco.
