FT: "Morgan Stanley now estimates, based on a total data-centre power requirement of 257GW by 2028, a gap of between 30 and 40% between US capacity and sales projections. Or to put it in layperson’s terms: 'NYC demands 5.5-6 GW of baseload power: we are short power by six New York Cities.'"

I believe the market continues to underestimate the intractability of the data center electricity challenge. As I dissect in my recent report on "The AI Trade" (https://t.co/wQQNniS2kj):

Even if data center builders are able to find the labor they need, that does not mean they can find the power they need. States are increasingly requiring data center projects to secure adequate power supply prior to breaking ground, whether from legacy grids or by supplying their own power. As we’ve highlighted in our reports previously, from the mid-2000s to the early 2020s, the US saw almost no electricity demand growth. In 2025, electricity generated grew by 2.8%, with data centers accounting for 55% of that growth, according to the EIA. Annual growth between 2% and 3% is expected through the end of the decade, with data center electricity demand more than doubling from 31 GW in 2025 to 66 GW in 2027.

Undoubtedly, data center providers are making best efforts to head off that challenge, working to shore up energy supply chains and build on-site power generation and battery storage capabilities. However, gains from those efforts are likely to still prove inadequate relative to the seismic electricity needs of data centers. For one, gas turbines are reportedly sold out through 2030, with prices spiking 195% since 2019. For another, delivery lead times for high-voltage transformers have ballooned from about a year in 2020 to upwards of two to four years.

In the months and years to come, we expect states to only tighten data center power supply requirements, leading to more delays in data center approvals. This is especially true given the effect data center electricity demand is having on electricity prices. As the Dallas Fed concluded in a March report: “Existing data centers have already increased wholesale prices by 2 to 6% on average nationwide, with substantially larger effects in regions hosting major data center corridors. Extending the model through 2028, we show that if proposed construction proceeds under high-utilization scenarios, wholesale prices could rise dramatically (50%).” The more Americans connect their affordability challenges to the AI buildout and exert their political influence, the more data center projects we expect to be delayed."

For my next report, I'm planning a dedicated deep-dive on "Global Electricity Undersupply". The challenge obviously goes well beyond data centers in a global economy electrifying across many fronts, from manufacturing to transportation to businesses and homes. Far more to come!

I've decided I'd rather take $0 than accept a settlement that requires me to stay silent about what happened to me. I have since fired my lawyers at @sanfordheisler & will be releasing all the evidence from my time @hack_vc on Wed 8/26.

INTRO: I've been in crypto for 9 years. Most recently I was a partner & head of platform @hack_vc which is a $600-700M crypto VC firm. Many of you may know me from my time as Head of Growth at @StellarOrg in 2017 (worked w/ the Mt. Gox founder), @Solana in 2018 (joined under ~10 ppl, but quit before my cliff), & @Fhenix in 2024. Or have attended one of my @DystopiaLabs ETH events (2019-now).

Last year, I was forced to work through a serious medical emergency while at @Hack_VC due to threats by @alpackaP @dbulaevsky, saying that they would blacklist me from the space if I quit before finishing the hacksummit conference & side events that I was helping with during @kbwofficial. I was working 13-14hr days, 6 days a week, sleeping 0-4 hrs a night, and had documented Graves' disease, hyperthyroidism, and severe insomnia. I repeatedly asked to quit. Hack VC refused. This + other threats and intimidation went on for almost a month.

The conditions got so bad I attempted suicide.

The fucked up part is that, even after the suicide attempt, I told everyone at Hack VC (in writing) that I had no plans to sue. I was scared & extremely sick. I just wanted to leave. I told them that as long as there was no retaliation or badmouthing - I had no plans to sue.

@Hack_VC chose to retaliate.

After just 1 month after my near suicide, Hack VC mishandled my COBRA health insurance, refused to fix things, kept shooing me to customer support (when it's legally Hack VC's responsibility to fix this), and my insurance had issues and was not fixed for almost 4 MONTHS. Hack VC did not fix everything until I hired lawyers and had them force Hack VC to adhere to the law & fix my COBRA insurance issues. The sheer cruelty of an employer harming someone's health insurance almost immediately after they nearly committed suicide is extremely fucked up.

And, even during the legal engagement, Hack VC continued to lie & attempt to harm me through their lawyers and other employees/partners (multi-million dollar carry & clawbacks can make even the nicest ppl willing to turn the other way or lie). @0xRodney @IsTheBaron @roshunpatel @Alex__Botte.

Now. Almost an entire year of engagement & my near suicide anniversary coming up, our lawyers (mine & Hack VC's) have reached the point of preparing for private mediation and settlement. And...I realized that I just can't do it. I don't want money in exchange for silence. I'd rather speak. 

I fired my lawyers yesterday.

In case it needs to be said, I did a good job at Hack VC. I was only there full time for 7 months; been part-time since 2021. This + my resume, should show that me suing is not a money grab; I was genuinely harmed.

I'm aware that I'm just one person (who is not rich) facing a $600-700M VC institution. I've been told by @alpackaP that he's known most of the managing partners at most VC firms for almost a decade and he could absolutely blacklist me. 
 
 I'm also painful aware that the conclusion of this will probably be extremely poor for me or death - but I've accepted it.

TLDR; I’m done with continued threats, pressure, and intimidation. I'm not going to take a payout and allow Alex or Hack VC to walk away from harming me. As mentioned, I'll be dropping the evidence from my case on Wed 8/26 (or before) -- privacy be damned.

기존 메모리 업체 입장에서는 성숙한 기술인 2D 6F2 구조를 연장하고 싶어함.

그리고 HBM이 이제 중요한 제품인데 4F2,3D DRAM은 구조를 완전히 바꾸는거라 HBM 같은 파생제품에 새로운 DRAM를 쓰려면 또 거기에 맞게 최적화 및 평가가 필요함.

반면 2D PoC(Peri on Cell)은 기존 구조와 차이가 별로 없는데 셀과 로직을 분리해서 로직에 여러 기능들도  더 넣을 수 있고 셀 면적도 늘어남.

삼성이 0a로 명명하긴 했지만 첫 제품은 1c cell로 할 가능성이 높음.

Samsung Electronics Revises Roadmap for Next Generation DRAM "D0a," Pulls Hybrid Bonding Forward

Samsung Electronics has revised its next generation DRAM development strategy. The company recently moved "B1b," a technology that had been under development as a standalone project, onto its official roadmap and designated it "D0a," its first DRAM below 10 nanometers (nm).

D0a originally referred to Samsung's vertical channel transistor (VCT) DRAM process. VCT DRAM has now been reclassified under a separate name, "D0a-V." Samsung changed the D0a designation to accelerate the adoption of advanced packaging in commodity DRAM. B1b refers to a technology that uses wafer to wafer (W2W) hybrid bonding to increase internal integration density.

"B1b was in R&D, but it was not on Samsung's official roadmap," said a source familiar with the matter. "With this strategy revision, it has been folded into D0a. It means Samsung is actively pushing for fast commercialization of B1b DRAM."

Samsung Shifts D0a Designation from VCT DRAM to B1b

According to ZDNet Korea's reporting on the 23rd, Samsung has changed the definition of its next generation D0a DRAM from VCT DRAM to B1b.

DRAM has advanced by shrinking internal circuit linewidths. The most recently commercialized DRAM is 1c (sixth generation 10nm class), with linewidths of around 11 to 12nm. The next product, 1d (seventh generation 10nm class), comes in at 10 to 11nm and is effectively the last 10nm class DRAM. These linewidth figures are marketing terms used to indicate performance, not actual physical dimensions.

Samsung has pursued several technological shifts to realize D0a, the first sub 10nm DRAM. B1b is the most prominent of these.

B1b fabricates the memory cells and the surrounding driver circuitry, known as the peri, on separate wafers and then bonds them together, stacking the cell on top of the peri. Compared with the conventional approach of integrating both cell and peri on a single wafer, this allows the cells to be packed more densely. It also lets each of the cell and the peri use a process optimized for it.

B1b uses W2W hybrid bonding. Hybrid bonding joins chips by directly connecting their copper interconnects. Compared with conventional packaging that connects chips through small bumps, it improves integration density and performance. W2W hybrid bonding is also entering full scale adoption in high layer count NAND of 400 layers or more. W2W means bonding one wafer to another.

Why Samsung Is Prioritizing B1b: "VCT DRAM Needs More Time"

VCT DRAM, previously called the D0a process, has been renamed D0a-V as a derivative. VCT stands up the transistor inside the DRAM cell, the smallest unit that stores data, vertically instead of laying it horizontally.

Making the transistor vertical reduces cell area. The conventional cell area, calculated by multiplying the feature size (F) in each direction, is 6F². VCT can bring this down to 4F². A smaller cell means more cells can be integrated in the same area.

VCT DRAM, however, is considered extremely difficult technically. It requires high aspect ratio etching to form vertical transistors and new materials to address the rise in leakage current that comes with smaller cell area.

W2W hybrid bonding, as used in B1b, is already in volume production in existing semiconductor processes such as CMOS image sensors and high layer count NAND. This appears to be why Samsung moved B1b ahead of VCT DRAM in priority for implementing the D0a process.

"From a design standpoint, B1b has a lower barrier to commercialization than VCT, so the industry sees early adoption of B1b as likely," another source said. "Inside Samsung, too, the mood is to move faster on B1b than on VCT."

**B1b to Play a Major Role in Next Generation AI Memory "HBM5"**

B1b could also play a significant role in Samsung's next generation high bandwidth memory (HBM) business. Samsung is currently reviewing applying B1b to HBM5 (eighth generation).

HBM5 is expected to enter mass production around 2029. Samsung is developing the product with a target of raising operating speed by roughly 50% or more over its predecessor, HBM4E.

Commercialization of B1b based D0a DRAM is estimated to be at least two years away. The industry expects the specific mass production investment schedule to be finalized around the middle of next year.

VCT DRAM development is continuing in parallel. The industry view is that VCT DRAM and 3D DRAM could eventually be developed on top of B1b. 3D DRAM stacks the cells themselves vertically and is expected to follow VCT DRAM.

"B1b will ultimately be applied alongside VCT DRAM or 3D DRAM," said Choi Jeongdong, Senior Vice President at TechInsights. "Manufacturing the cell and peri separately brings many advantages, so hybrid bonding will serve as a platform applied together with future DRAM cell architectures."

Pre Market Thoughts - 23 Sep 26

Yields are a touch lower. Oil is lower. QQQ stands at ATH. Meanwhile if you look at insti surveys, we just had the most bearish surveys by instis. Prime brokerage data also says that on a 1 year look back we are at record low AND gross positioning.

On yields, i made the call before that we have seen the high in yields. I still hold on to that belief. With the massive amount of short positioning in treasuries, i think there will soon be a short squeeze across the treasury complex.

This when QQQ is at near ATH is the fuel that pushes QQQ up into a breakout.

Meanwhile semis are also at the lows in terms of valuation (it is simply a feature of earnings running faster than price growth). I also see that we are near ATHs for SOXX and would expect the next part of the breakout to underfold in the semis space. My tickers are NBIS/SNDK/00660/SKHY/SOXL/TQQQ.

On the calender (https://t.co/5UivpnpGfy) > CALENDAR. This week we have the Xi-Trump meeting to begin shortly. Next week $MU earnings drop on Tuesday, 1 Oct. This will be an interesting event to look towards for semis pricing and guidance.

In particular, i have rotated some exposure out from SOXL into TQQQ because i foresee some strong price appreciation across the hyperscaler complex. $META's repricing is not yet even fully done and i expect the rest of the hyperscalers to get validated as well. Again, there is record low correlation happening underneath the index surface which is the reason why i am choosing these 3X ETF tools, to defray the vol drag. The 3X of the index performance will be better than the 3X of the mean stock performance in a low correlation regime.

In crypto, $BTC continues to consolidate after making a strong move up. On alts, i continue to like AI theme - $TAO, $PRL. $PRL in particular has almost doubled from when i dropped the ticker. For those concerned about inflation, i would strongly suggest looking at the mining cost of $PRL. After factoring in GPU rental + electricity, throughout a large part of $PRL history, mining cost was significantly above market price. Hence why i never bothered with trying to mine it. Most of the $PRL miners are those with already a large inventory of RTX GPU cards who do it to recoup some of their fixed costs, mostly chinese miners.

The investment thesis for $PRL in my opinion is still very nascent. It was the same logic as buying $TAO when it was 80. There were no subnets, no infrastructure. Just a theme and a roadmap and a team that seemed it could deliver. Make no mistake here, $PRL is very much a early VC like bet. There is nothing concrete i can point to - i.e you can buy inference with $PRL right now. At the same time, thematic investments like these have no ceiling. See $ZEC vs $HYPE. I dont think it is for everyone. It appeals to risk on speculators like me. The main reason why i am aggressive in buying this is simply because it is so difficult to buy that i know that everyone is underpositioned in this. For those who require cashflows, there are plenty of other tickers for you to look at.

The second part of this will be posted in the terminal

Good luck!

本周除了川习会外最大看点来了— 是马斯克刚刚重申： $SPCX  大火箭🚀

7天后，星舰将进行人类历史上第一次真正入轨发射。

9月21日，马斯克转发SpaceX推文确认：助推器Booster 21已运抵星基地2号发射台，将与Ship 41配对。

9月28日左右，星舰第14次飞行将首次冲入地球轨道，并投放26颗真正投入运营的Starlink V3卫星。

为什么这件事能压过本周所有科技新闻？原因很硬核。

第一，这是质变，不是又一次测试。 前13次飞行全是亚轨道，飞完就掉下来。这次要真正绕地球飞大约6圈、近10小时，第一次完成入轨点火。星舰从“试验火箭”正式跨进“轨道级运载工具”。

第二，第一次装真正赚钱的货。 以前扔的是测试件，这次26颗是要长期工作的V3卫星。每颗V3单星容量约1Tbps，一次发射直接给星链增加26Tbps带宽，相当于10次猎鹰9号打V2 Mini的总容量。星舰第一次开始产生实际商业价值。

第三，V3卫星猎鹰9号根本装不下。 V3又大又重，外形也完全不是猎鹰整流罩能塞的尺寸。只有星舰这种9米级巨型飞船才能批量把它送上天。这次成功，等于星链下一代网络真正开张。

第四，完全可重复使用只差临门一脚。 这次助推器和飞船都还是溅落，不抓回收。但Flight 15就要尝试抓飞船。这次入轨成功，等于把最难的“先活着进轨道、再安全回来”走通，后面才能谈快速复飞、像飞机一样重复使用。

第五，时间卡得刚刚好。 马斯克说“7天后”。助推器已经上发射台，静态点火和测试刚完成。就差监管放行。这不是远期规划，是本周就能盯着倒计时的大事。

总结： 星舰不再只是“看起来很猛的试验”，而是第一次真正把下一代互联网卫星送进轨道。成功了，廉价大运力时代加速到来；失败了，也是人类迈向多行星物种路上必须交的学费。

本周最值得盯着看的，就是这一发。起码我觉得最有看点

text:
Investing is about investing in people.

What Nate is demonstrating right now is an extreme sense of mission + an exceptionally high level of personal commitment + an almost irrational optimism toward his goal, but I don’t think this should simply be understood as “obsession.”

What is truly worth paying attention to is that Nate is publicly expressing a very strong Founder–Mission Binding:

“I moved my entire life… left family, close friends, even my girl.”

“we generate a lot of impact by being optimistic… to the point of almost being delusional.”

“the mission is too big and we will keep pushing every single day like it’s day 1.”

He is not saying, “LONG is a good project and I’m very bullish on it.” He is expressing that LONG has already become part of his personal life choices.

In other words, he has tied his own time, opportunity cost, and personal choices to LONG’s long-term mission.

And his final statement:

“we are going to break every possible ceiling and create generational assets stock by stock.”

is even more important.

“Generational assets” is connected to Nate’s previous positioning of LONG.

Previously, LONG’s direction was:

RWA Pairs → Net New Use Cases → Liquidity Infrastructure

Now Nate is taking that goal one step further and turning it into a broader narrative:

Stock by Stock → Asset by Asset → Generational Assets

So this is no longer simply “I want to make LONG bigger.”

It is more like:

LONG is not a short-term product, but a long-term mission.

This also reminds me of a similar pattern displayed by Elon in his early entrepreneurial years — not that Nate and Elon are the same kind of person, but rather that some extreme entrepreneurs tend to exhibit a very strong behavioral pattern:

The goal is big enough → the real-world conditions are clearly insufficient → the founder increases their personal commitment instead → extreme optimism is used to offset uncertainty → the team is brought together by that belief → if the product eventually succeeds, what initially looked almost crazy is later understood as Founder Vision.

So what really matters is not how “crazy” Nate is, but whether he can turn that extreme conviction and personal commitment into actual product results.

That is also why I think this LONG post is more meaningful than simply saying “LONG to the moon.”

Because Nate is not repeating a price narrative. He is repeating a very clear direction:

Stock by Stock → RWA → Assets → LONG

And this is consistent with our previous analysis of LONG.

Previously, LONG looked more like:

Launchpad → RWA Launchpad → RWA Trading / Liquidity Infrastructure

Now Nate’s personal expression is taking it one level higher:

LONG → RWA Asset Infrastructure → Long-term Asset Platform

So this post itself is not a new product catalyst, nor is it new data proving anything.

What it really reinforces is:

Founder Commitment + Long-term Mission

Especially when he publicly mentions moving to a new state for LONG and leaving family and friends, he is sending a very clear signal to the community:

“I’m not treating LONG as a short-term project. I’m willing to invest my life in building it for the long term.”

For an early-stage project, this does matter, because the market is not only looking at the product. It is also looking at:

Will this Founder actually keep building for the long term?

At the same time, we have to distinguish:

Founder Commitment ≠ Product Validation

A founder can be extremely committed, but whether LONG can ultimately become the “generational assets” he describes still needs to be validated through real RWA trading volume, the number of assets, liquidity, users, and actual ecosystem usage.

So the real significance of this post is not that LONG’s fundamentals have suddenly changed. Rather, Nate is publicly confirming that LONG’s long-term goal is no longer simply to “build an RWA Launchpad,” but to gradually build RWA asset and trading infrastructure.

What is truly worth watching next is whether Nate can turn this vision into a real asset network, one stock, one asset, and one trading use case at a time.

text:
Explaining why BTC bottomed earlier than usual is of course a game of speculation, and of course no one will be able to prove definitively what the reason was. 

But, one of the things that struck me about people that remained entirely sidelined is that there was simply a lack of belief in the asset, and what the the purpose of the asset is nowadays contrary to the past.

BTC for most of its life cycle has been a risk on asset that was primarily correlated with tech. 

This was despite repeated narratives about digital gold, protection against debasement etc. 

Whilst the properties of BTC made those above narratives true, the PA never really lined up with them despite some believers repeating them ad nauseam.  

I believe that the majority of buyers in previous bear markets were mostly speculators that bought BTC for its fast money potential as a fast horse, as opposed to allocators buying it for its SOV properties. Most people didn't want to buy BTC as a hard money SOV in previous bears.

I think what is different about Bitcoin now is that over the course of the last few years due to the insutitionalization of the asset, and global investor education by Blackrock and co, it has shed its identity as a risk on/tech asset and largely embraced the SOV hard money debasement protection identity.

It has become palatable for institutional allocators and fund managers to recommend a core allocation of BTC in traditional portfolios. I have noticed this with institutional portfolio services that I follow myself.

In my humble opinion, when Bessent announced bond buybacks it acted as white swan catalyst for BTC to exit its bottom range as global investors recognised that Bitcoin was the asset to buy in that moment. It became correlated again with Gold, and did exactly what it should have done in that moment.  

Now, you either believed in the asset at that moment and its SOV qualities and hard money identity, or you didn't, and you still held in your mind that it was a risk on asset despite that identity largely making little sense from first principles.

I think this is primarily why people sidelined themselves on Bitcoin (the old four year cycles are an extension of this), as there were expecting the world to give them a much bigger discount again as was historically tradition, and they would take the risk on an unloved risk on/tech asset, but this time was in fact different.

text:
其实去年就融完了，那会产品也没好，就一直没发。正好最近个人版APP重新上线，想着补个PR也感谢一下。

首先想感谢下投资人们的信任，去年经历了被盗和转型，几乎是从零起步的状态，但大家还是愿意相信和支持我们。

然后是感谢用户和团队的信任，大家一起塑造了我们的产品和品牌。

一年的时间变化很大。团队的变化、市场的变化、产品的变化、我个人的变化。或许有些战略决策能做得更好，而贯穿每一日的选择更是有很多可以复盘的。这一路来，学会了敬畏，感受到了肩上的责任，而最终更需要落实到每一个细节。

赛道很卷，我们也还有很多不完善的地方。想做好一个Fintech产品确实需要踩很多坑，操不少心，筛选更踏实负责的人，而且都需要时间检验和积累。这个行业很难产生爆款，但胜在细水长流，坚持日复一日的优化和持续的平衡，才能最终造就卓越的产品和服务。

正式算下来，我们花了一整年时间重新学习了这个行业，交付了一百多项功能和更新，完善成了一个全方位的金融平台，并且迫不及待地以更快的速度、更低的成本、更稳定可靠的金融系统继续前行。

AI的出现一方面或许会加大贫富差距，但另一方面应该也会让金融平权的进程有彻底的改变。对于大多数人来说，他们需要的不是10-100，而是0-1的那个质变。Infini不会追求那个空中楼阁的建设，但会慢慢思考究竟该如何在差异化的同时真正把这项技术普惠于日常生活。

text:
The customer has written DO NOT CLOSE MY COMPLAINT on a check. I run billing for an internet-and-TV provider. We have cashed everything except that sentence.

We charged him $64 to install his internet and another $64 to install it again. There was 1 visit. The customer has sent us his doorbell footage. It shows a man entering with a router and leaving without it, which is exactly the service we advertise.

He paid both charges because he works from home and needs the connection. Our system closed his complaint when the balance reached $0. This saves our agents from bothering people who have already agreed with us financially.

The check was his attempt to be clearer. His next monthly bill was $80. He sent $16, deducting the $64 we owed him, with a letter specifying which charge he refused to pay.

I applied the $16 to his monthly service. This left $64 owing for internet. His installation remained paid in full.

He called to say I had put the money in the wrong place.

I explained that he had paid part of the bill he had just received. He said he was withholding part of the bill he had already paid.

We both had calculators. It was an unusually well-equipped call.

He wanted the unpaid $64 moved back to the installation. I told him that would require reopening a settled charge. He said yes. I told him it was settled.

He asked if the technician could come back and uninstall just the second installation.

I checked. We could send a technician. There would be a charge.

The customer went quiet. I could hear him typing. He was doing arithmetic, which generally brings people around.

He paid everything except 1 cent.

In his email, he explained that the cent represented the entire unresolved dispute. He had canceled AutoPay, deleted his saved card and set a daily reminder to check his balance. He had also told his wife about the cent. They had agreed nobody was to touch it.

I admired his preparation. Most customers let the computer do all this for them.

On Monday, an agent offered him extra time to pay.

He accepted immediately. He asked for as much time as possible. The agent was pleased to be dealing with someone so willing to discuss his debt.

On Tuesday, another agent offered to clear it as a courtesy.

He demanded a supervisor.

That was me. He wanted a note placed on the account saying we must never forgive the cent. I asked whether he understood this would leave him owing us money. He said that was the point.

I read it back to him. Slowly. I wanted the recording to be usable.

Our accounts team removes tiny balances before sending overdue accounts for further action. I explained that his cent might disappear at the end of the month.

"How much do I have to owe you for you to leave it alone?"

I said I couldn't recommend an amount.

He offered $5.

I said that would certainly attract more attention.

He asked how to get his balance back up. I suggested a movie rental. He wanted our cheapest. I found a film he already owned.

He rented it. He asked whether watching it would weaken his complaint. I said I couldn't advise him. He stayed on the phone while the charge appeared.

"Is it there?" he asked.

"$5.01."

"And you won't remove it?"

"I can make a note."

He asked for a screenshot. I sent it. He asked for the case number. I read it out. He made me read it again.

After 47 minutes, he thanked me. I thanked him. It had taken several departments, but we had found something he wanted to be charged for.

He gave the call 5 stars.

I attached the survey to his original complaint.

text:
预测市场的移动流量入口Bagel  @bagel_win 投研报告 

很久没写投研报告了，看到很多群友在玩 Bagel ，深度投研后又玩了2天

先说结论，如果喜欢预测市场赛道, Bagel 完全可玩！

Bagel 目前的核心模式，是接入 Polymarket 流动性，再通过移动端 UX、跟单、AI、社交和活动运营，把更多普通用户带进预测市场。

所以， Bagel 有望成为 Polymarket 生态里的流量入口和交易分发层

以下是投研报告分析👇
1. 商业模式已经比较清晰
Bagel 目前主要通过交易手续费变现。
市价单大于等于 5 美元收取 1%，低于 5 美元固定 0.05 美元，限价单 0.5%。

同时返还 Polymarket Taker Fee，通过跟单机制把部分手续费分给被跟单的交易者。

他们的这个设计就比较强了，因为这相当于把交易、内容和社交关系串在了一起。
交易员负责产生策略和内容，普通用户负责跟单，Bagel 从交易行为中获得收入。

如果用户规模持续扩大，理论上可以形成比较直接的交易量增长逻辑。

2. Bagel 真正的差异化是用户层
Polymarket 已经有很强的流动性和品牌，Bagel 很难在底层市场上形成优势。

所以，它走的竞争用户体验。
体育、电竞、Crypto、政治等市场全部做成移动端信息流，用户可以看仓位、看胜率、跟单、聊天，再直接下单。
尤其是世界杯、五大联赛、LoL、Dota 这类场景，预测市场具有很强的消费属性。

Bagel 的增长逻辑更接近消费 App，但是在传统交易终端方面没有竞争力

3. 数据增长指标
Bagel 今年5 月份上线后，成交量增长还是很快的，在公开数据里
-6 月中旬累计成交约 250 万美元
-7 月中旬累计成交已经超过 1000 万美元，并进入 Polymarket Builders 排名前列。
-7活跃用户已有 3200 人

虽然规模不大，但对于一个上线几个月的早期产品来说，已经非常不错了

4. 产品边界的空间
创始人 Chess 蔡司说了预测市场只是第一步。长期方向是全链上、7×24、无需许可的社交交易 App，并计划继续拓展 Perp、现货、期权等资产。

所以，未来Bagel 还是有望成为以仓位和交易行为为核心的链上社交交易入口。这也是我觉得 Bagel 最大的潜在弹性。

5.风险点
第一是 Polymarket 依赖
Bagel 的核心流动性来自 Polymarket，如果polymarket调整 Builders 政策、手续费或者官方 App 的能力，都会直接影响 Bagel。

第二是 官方 App 竞争
Polymarket 已经推出了 app 版，Bagel 还是要做大差异化来提升竞争力

不过风险点针对的是Bagel 本身，对于普通玩家来说可以忽略

以上的一些投研内容已经说明Bagel 完全可玩，不是三无项目。

对于喜欢玩预测的来说，Bagel 最厉害的是跟单的功能。

如果想参与自己不擅长的预测，想拿到好的结果，最简单的方式就是跟单！

可以直接找胜率高的玩家，然后直接复制仓位。而且被跟单的人也能获得收益（Bagel 会把跟单产生的部分手续费回流给被跟单者）。

Bagel还很早期，之前看到消息暗示早期参与者可能有奖励。目前上面有不少预测奖池活动，看了下前排的交易量，并不卷。喜欢玩预测的可以去瞅瞅~

Tips: 本文不做投资建议，预测市场有风险，不擅长一定慎玩,DYOR！

text:
Pendle 의 비전 - 모든 Yield 의 블랙홀

Yield 는 모든 금융에서 가장 중요한 도구이자, 돈이 움직이는 중심축 입니다.
Pendle 은 온체인 토큰 수익율을 다루는 V2 와 무기한 선물 펀딩비 마켓인 Boros 를 통해 온체인 세상의 모든 수익율을 흡수하겠다는 비전을 선포 하였습니다

Pendle 은 V2 와 Boros 를 통해 유저들에게 스테이블 코인, 토큰화 RWA, 무기한선물과 펀딩비에 대해 성향에 따라 베팅할 수 있는 기회를 열어주었고, 이를 통해 함께 성장해 왔습니다.

Wave1. Stablecoin

현재 스테이블 코인 공급량은 3천억달러 (전년대비 +14%)
Citi 는 2030 년까지 1.9조 달러 / SC는 28년 2조 달러 전망
Pendle 은 ETH 상 USDG 의 28% 보유, X Layer 에서는 체인 TVL 의 40% 가 Pendle USDG 마켓
Pendle Effect 로 스테이블 코인 수요 급증이 반복되고 있음

Wave2. Tokenized RWA

스테이블 제외 Tokenized RWA 는 현재 390억 달러로, 2년새 약 4배 성장
2030년 전망은 2~16조 달러 이상
올핸 출시된 Pendle 마켓 중 66개가 RWA 연계
Morpho RWA PT 2.1억 달러, STRC 마켓 5억달러, USDai 5.68억 달러 기록

'수익율 없는 자산도 PT/YT 화 할수 있는 기술 공개 예정'

Wave3. Perp and Funding Rate

Perp 의 남은 성장 영역은 주식/상품 연계. Ethena 와 같은 입장
Stock Perp OI 는 60억 달러로 6개월만에 10배 이상 성장, Hyperliquid Stock RWA 거래량은 올해 2120억 달러로, 50배 성장
다만, 펀딩비 변동성이 매우 큼. HL 가중 평균 연 14%, Binance 17.5%, 원유는 BTC 보다 14배 변동성이 크고, SKHynics 는 일일 펀딩 표준편차 163% 수준
Boros 는 펀딩비를 고정하건, 캐리트레이드/펀딩비 방향성 베팅을 가능케 함
CrossEx 같은 프라임 브로커와 결합해 20~40% APR 차익거래도 실행 가능
왜 Pendle 인가 "The Pendle Pull"

 - 자산 발행사에게 유통채널, 유틸리티, 유동성을 한번에 제공
 - PT 는 담보로 쓰이고, 크로스체인 PT 도 활용 중
 - 인센티브 모듈로 인해 유동성 효율 크게 향상

따라서 스테이블/RWA/Perp 가 각각 성장할때, 그 수익률이 모일 깊은 단일 창구가 Pendle 임

比赛期间周边封路、绕行，坐 MRT 通常更省心。先看门票对应的入场口，再选下车站，不是所有人都去同一个站

而且相关封路安排从 10 月 7 日就开始了，主会期间也会影响部分滨海湾周边交通

💡地铁支付提前准备好：

▫️带非接触支付标志、符合要求的 Visa／Mastercard，可以直接刷

▫️或者买 EZ-Link 交通卡

▫️微信、支付宝付款码不能直接当作这里的地铁乘车码

▫️进出站用同一张卡或同一台手机，别进去刷手机、出来换实体卡

去 TOKEN2049 主会场，地铁认准 Bayfront 站，不是 Marina Bay 站；

打车直接搜 Sands Expo & Convention Centre，不要只填「金沙酒店」

4️⃣ Side Event 不用报满，先想清楚自己想见谁

找活动可以收藏这张 @punk2898  做的中文地图：https://t.co/0isEbrvjoV

先定当天最想去的一两场，再找附近顺路的活动。地图帮你找线索，最终时间、费用、地址和入场要求，还是看主办方原页面

也不用把社交全部安排在晚上。晨跑、早餐会、咖啡局、Workshop，都可以认识人。

5️⃣ 住哪里

▫️乌节路附近活动多：优先看 Orchard 一带。
▫️主会安排满：优先考虑去金沙方便的位置。
▫️想兼顾预算和交通：可以看看 Bugis、Bencoolen、Chinatown，具体看酒店离地铁多远。

订房之前可以多看一眼含税总价、取消政策、有没有窗、是不是独立卫浴，以及到地铁实际要走多远。房费省下来的钱，别最后都花在打车上😂

退房当天还要继续跑会的话，提前问好酒店能不能寄存行李，给取行李和去机场留够时间

6️⃣ 吃饭可以简单，约饭尽量提前

想吃本地餐食、控制预算，可以把 Maxwell、牛车水大厦熟食中心、老巴刹放进备选。早餐找顺路的亚坤，正餐也可以考虑松发

想吃辣椒蟹，就提前订位、问清重量和价格，不要夹在两场会议之间赶着吃

餐厅标价后面如果有“++”，记得看服务费和税。比如收取 10% 服务费和 9% GST 时，标价 S$100，最后是 S$119.90

熟食中心吃完记得收好托盘、餐具和桌面垃圾

7️⃣ 最后：出发前检查清单

□ SG Arrival Card：抵达前的三天内提交，包含抵达当天。ICA 官方渠道免费，免签不等于不用填

□ 手机卡：有流量不一定能打电话、收短信，原手机号记得保留接验证码的能力

□ 支付：可用的银行卡＋少量新币现金，留个备用 

□ 随身带：薄外套、雨具、充电宝、好走路的鞋 

□ 入场凭证：提前存好，晒图记得打码 

□ 约见地址：写清哪家酒店、哪一层、哪个入口

如果晚上正好在金沙附近，也可以留点时间看水舞秀，或者去滨海湾花园看灯光。但是需要留意当天开放和交通安排嗷！

10 月，大家，新加坡见！

text:
Been holding and mentioning $MONEY for some time now, but never shared my thesis. 
So here it is:

I feel like they did something really unique to stablecoins, and very in-line with the current meta. 

Until now, stablecoins like USDC and USDT were backed mostly by US Treasuries and cash held by the issuer.

The yield on those reserves? It goes to Circle and Tether. You only get a dollar that sits still.

What if your dollar was backed by the S&P 500, and the upside stayed with you?

That's what Own is building.

Deposit eSPY (a token tracking the S&P 500, backed 1:1 by real tokenized stock in a protocol-owned reserve). Mint eUSD against it at 150% collateral. Keep every bit of upside on your stocks while you spend, trade, or farm with the dollars.

Important, the peg isn't just a promise. Any holder can redeem 1 eUSD for exactly $1 of eSPY. 

And they built in an amazing flywheel for their protocol token $MONEY:

Stake eUSD and you earn yield paid from $MONEY trading fees. 

Hold $MONEY and you boost that yield.

That's where it gets interesting. Normally, more stakers means a thinner APR for everyone. Here, it's the feature instead of the bug:

More eUSD staked → more $MONEY needed to max the boost → more $MONEY buying and volume → more trading fees → APR climbs back up → more people mint and stake eUSD.

Wall Street built the world's best collateral.
DeFi built the world's best money rails.
Own is plugging one into the other.

Think this coin can do very well during the next leg up of the Robinhood eco.

AI真正普及了以后，会大大提高散户交易的下限。

散户一般都只花时间关注自己的上限，幻想挣了钱以后买这买那的。其实可能要等到亏完才终于意识到，很多在做的事情比如高杠杆，短线频繁交易，交易极小标的都是负数学期望行为。

低下限行为只会加快他们亏损的速度。这时候，把他们的下限提高才是最重要的。AI起码不会真去做这种表面上看来极度弱智的交易行为。

低门槛市场需要高认知才能稳定盈利。

quoted_text:
川普施压也留谈判空间，各国推动霍尔木兹恢复通航

川普今天在联合国还是一边对伊朗放狠话，一边强调可以谈。他要求各国全面经济孤立伊朗，要求恢复霍尔木兹通航，重申不能让伊朗拥有核武器，还保留进一步动武的选择，但同时又说，相信中期选举后能够达成协议。

他指责伊朗袭击商船、违反停火，也声称美国仍在帮助油轮通过海峡。鲁比奥随后表示愿意在联大期间与伊朗接触，只是还没有安排会谈。从这些表态看，川普仍然希望靠压力让伊朗接受条件，愿意谈的态度也是明确的。

毕竟美伊即使谈成，海湾国家仍然要与伊朗做邻居，也不希望下一次美伊发生冲突，自己又成为被攻击的对象。阿联酋因此强调，地区安全还需要伊朗与阿拉伯国家直接谈，周边国家必须参与这些安排，自己的安全诉求也要被放到谈判桌上。

text:
The collapse of the Clarity Act in the Senate has not created a regulatory vacuum so much as it has returned the United States to the older pattern that has defined digital-asset oversight for more than a decade: agencies filling statutory gaps with the tools they already possess. 

That pattern began long before Congress attempted a comprehensive market-structure bill. The 1946 Howey test became the SEC’s main instrument for treating token sales as investment contracts. FinCEN’s 2013 guidance placed exchanges under Bank Secrecy Act rules. The 2017 DAO report extended securities logic to ICOs, while the CFTC treated Bitcoin and later Ether as commodities and authorized futures around them. Dual jurisdiction without a clear line produced years of enforcement rather than prospective rules.

The enforcement-first era intensified after 2022. Lawsuits against major platforms, SAB 121’s restrictive custody accounting, and delayed spot Bitcoin ETFs made legal risk outweigh operational clarity. FIT21, passed by the House in 2024, tried to draw a statutory boundary: sufficiently decentralized tokens would fall to the CFTC as digital commodities, others remaining SEC securities. It never became law. 

A later administration dismissed some cases and rescinded SAB 121, yet the jurisdictional ambiguity remained. The GENIUS Act later created a framework for payment stablecoins but left broader market-structure questions unresolved.

The Clarity Act was meant to finish that work. Building on FIT21, it would have given the CFTC spot-market oversight of digital commodities, required intermediary registration, opened paths for tokenized securities, and limited conflicting state rules. 

After passing the House in 2025, it spent months in Senate talks over stablecoin yields, banking concerns, and ethics restrictions on officials profiting from the assets they would regulate. Those talks failed. 

On September 15 the Senate rejected cloture 49–50. Democrats cited inadequate safeguards against conflicts tied to the president’s crypto ventures; several Republicans objected over banking and yield issues. A procedural maneuver left a narrow path for reconsideration, but the pre-midterm calendar is short.

Agencies moved within days. The SEC created a temporary exemption for trading tokenized equities, a step toward continuous markets. The CFTC sent proposed rules on crypto transactions and markets to the White House. Both had already coordinated under Project Crypto and issued joint guidance classifying major tokens as digital commodities. 

Custody rules are under review. Officials say they will use existing authority rather than wait for Congress. Industry voices that once demanded a statute now treat agency action as an acceptable Plan B.

The distinction still matters. A statute is hard to unwind; an interpretive release can be rewritten by the next chair. Traditional-finance firms may now proceed, yet they will price in possible reversal. State attorneys general retain fraud-enforcement power. Federal agencies can design market architecture; states can still pursue the scams that fill the gaps. 

What remains is not the clean congressional settlement the industry sought, but a familiar compromise: regulators writing the rulebook they were never given, while Congress keeps a remote option to legislate later. The Clarity Act’s failure did not freeze the market. It returned the work of defining digital assets to the same two agencies that have argued over them since the first tokens appeared, now with a clearer instruction to finish the job themselves.

text:
POLYMARKET DIGEST — 23 SEPTEMBER 2026

🔥 News & Announcements

The Polymarket team is actively investigating weather data source issues. ak504111 confirmed internal discussions are underway about potentially reverting to Wunderground as a temporary fix, while a longer-term solution is being developed. The team also confirmed they are looking into hourly temperature markets similar to Kalshi's new offering.

maskache07 proposed reverting to Wunderground immediately and forming a small private working group of experienced traders to design a permanent solution before any new rules are pushed.

⚠️ Bugs & Issues

Critical trade routing bug: olegs_13 reported losing $3,000 after buying shares in one market only to have the order execute in a completely different market. This has allegedly happened 3–4 times.

Redemption failure: jcsnc99 reported ~$1,577 in resolved winning positions stuck unredeemed since Sep 14 on one wallet, with "Claim all" reverting mid-process when mixing negRisk and standard markets in a batch.

Share balance not recognized: A user in #climate reported being unable to exit a ~$1,600 position, with the UI returning "Not enough shares" despite confirmed holdings. ak504111 escalated and requested a screen recording.

Weather data outages: https://t.co/rXv8V4e9Ds (via Synopticdata) has been experiencing repeated data gaps, affecting multiple city markets including Lucknow, Manila, Cape Town, and Panama. The Panama market saw no 15:00 temperature reading, with the outage confirmed on both aviationweather and Wunderground as well.

X Tracker undercounting: sabari_stocks flagged that the White House X post tracker missed several posts from Sunday's "Summer 250 Photo Dump," reporting 204 original posts for the week of Sep 15–22 and asking for a recount before resolution.

CLOB API false-positive ban: polywatchdog reported receiving a 400 "address banned" error from the CLOB API despite respecting all rate limits, and believes it is a false positive. tsmultra asked for a DM with the proxy address.

Order placement latency: Multiple users reported laggy order placement (~10 seconds). skulldoom97 stated latencies should be better, and chickenwing_14999 confirmed improvements on their end, though artex6666 reported severe latency spikes again later in the day.

WebSocket delivery skew: oleh931816 documented WS market update delays of up to 686ms (p99 >100ms) on AWS eu-west-2, with individual markets stalling while others on the same connection continue normally. 830lincoln confirmed experiencing the same, with delays up to 10+ seconds, noting the issue returned after being fixed about a year ago.

CLOB signature latency disparity: th0rped0 measured that accounts created after May 4, 2026 are locked into the deposit wallet flow (type 3 signatures), which is consistently 6–8ms slower than type 2, and ~10ms slower than legacy type 1 accounts. blunkoed suggested waiting for CLOB 2.0, expected end of year.

📋 Clarifications

Regarding the weather data source debate, notaforecaster_32454 clarified that https://t.co/rXv8V4e9Ds pulls from the Synopticdata API, while Wunderground uses https://t.co/83hZojGCUF's API, and suggested https://t.co/lilDkXTC5I as the closest raw source. However, user_v123 noted tgftp only retains 24 hours of history and does not include SPECIs in cycle files, making dispute resolution problematic. The https://t.co/nnE6FEUiJQ API was raised as an alternative with archiving and SPECI support. user_v123 also suggested considering a switch to Celsius to avoid temperature conversion rounding issues inherent to Fahrenheit/METAR T-group parsing.

ak504111 clarified that the rules already allow fallback to Wunderground when WRH data is fully missing, and indicated the team will add clarity on what constitutes "missing data" to potentially cover partial outages as well.

If you had to choose between Polymarket reverting to Wunderground immediately versus waiting for a perfect long-term solution, which would you pick?

text:
In 2023, I decided to focus almost entirely on @pendle_fi.

Why?

I simply saw the PMF.

Now I'm seeing the same pattern again.

This time with @boros_fi.

Pendle changed DeFi forever by opening opportunities that weren't available before.

Pendle became the place where yield products wanted to be listed and where users could access some of the most attractive yields in DeFi.

Boros is becoming a major venue for funding-rate trading, arbitrage and hedging.

But what really interests me isn't just the high APR.

It's the whole infrastructure underneath it.

Funding-rate arbitrage has existed for years, but it was mostly a strategy for professional desks.

You needed capital across multiple exchanges, multiple margin accounts and active management of both sides.

@Gate CrossEx changes that.

One collateral pool can support the positions across venues, while the Arbitrage Terminal from the Pendle team makes the entire strategy dramatically easier to execute.

In practice, it looks like this.

You open a 4-leg position: two Boros legs and two perps through CrossEx.

The Terminal does it in two clicks and locks in a fixed APR, often around 20% or more, instead of leaving you exposed to floating funding.

And I believe this can eventually make funding-rate arbitrage accessible to a much larger pool of capital.

I can see Boros becoming one of the main venues for investors and funds looking to access fixed-rate funding strategies.

Double-digit fixed APRs are something capital allocators naturally want access to.

Of course, it's still very early.

Large funds don't just deploy meaningful capital into a new product overnight.

The product needs to be battle-tested, liquidity needs to grow, infrastructure needs to mature and the operational side needs to become institutional-grade.

But that's exactly why I think we're early.

Step by step, as adoption grows, I can see funding-rate and fixed-rate strategies becoming a much larger and more systematic allocation inside investment portfolios.

Boros doesn't exist in isolation.

Just to be clear, everything below is my forward-looking thesis.

Boros revenue is not currently being directly shared with PENDLE or sPENDLE holders.

As Boros scales, it can become a meaningful additional revenue source for Pendle.

If this happens, the potential winners aren't just the users earning attractive yields.

There is another potential winner:

$PENDLE holders.

And potentially an even bigger beneficiary:

$sPENDLE holders.

I believe Boros can eventually generate meaningful value for PENDLE holders through Pendle's value-accrual mechanism, with buybacks helping offset emissions and benefiting sPENDLE holders.

This is why I don't think we've seen the full Boros story yet.

Funding-rate arbitrage is only the first chapter.

Boros will evolve in many more ways from here.

Maybe that's why it's already in the name: Boros.

Based on the ancient Greek word meaning “to eat.”

Boros eats everything.

Then redistributes it to its participants.

runescape was a big part of my life

id spend 5-7 hours every single day after school grinding to be a pure mage, i dont even remember doing hw lol

stopped at lvl 89 because runes got too expensive 

i had 2 accounts

one was good at everything, but my overall level was too high, so id get clapped in the wilderness

my pure mage though...

amazing at pvp

i worked for over a year to finally get enough gp to trade for a santa hat, one of the rarest items in the game

it was fking insane

back then, there wasn't an easy way to transfer items between your accounts

you had to log into the same server on both, go to the exact same secluded spot, drop the item, log out, then log into your other account and wait for it to appear

so obviously, i wanted my lvl 89 pure mage to flex the santa hat

i found a secluded spot

checked everywhere to make sure no one was around

brought both accounts there

dropped the santa hat

logged out

and suddenly...

i couldn't log back in

i don't remember if the server was full or my internet was bugging out, but i was panicking

by the time i finally got back in

the santa hat was gone

and there was some random guy nearby SCREAMING that he just found a santa hat

i begged him to give it back

begged and begged

he just ran away

then disappeared and logged off

one of the saddest days of my life 😭

i quit runescape forever after that

but looking back, im weirdly grateful for all of it

spending that much time on the game as a kid gave me a lens for so many things i see on the internet today

different game
different graphics
different money

but somehow, everything is still the same

the markets, the flexing, the grinding, the scams, the rare items, the communities, the gambling, the friends

runescape will probably always be a part of how i see the internet

and most importantly...

doubling money

text:
不是伪需求。就像开源和闭源一样，我更倾向于认为，去中心化与中心化 AI 从长期来看不是非此即彼的竞争关系，而是会长期共存，两者各有所长。

中心化 AI 的优势是资源集中、产品迭代快、商业化效率高；去中心化 AI 的价值，则在于开放参与、资源协同以及让更多模型、算力、数据和服务能够形成一个开放的网络。

所以我认为，真正需要验证的，其实不是“去中心化 AI 有没有需求”，而是它能不能最终做出足够好的产品，并产生规模化的商业价值。

至于商业化，这确实需要耐心。整个 AI 行业本身都还处在非常早期，今天我们看到真正大规模商业化兑现的，主要还是少数头部模型和推理服务，AI 后面还有很大的发展空间。

所以对 bittensor:native ，我目前更愿意把它看成一个需要时间去验证的长期方向，而不是现在就要求它完成商业价值兑现。现在最重要的，还是看它能不能持续吸引成千上万的项目开发者进来、从而产生更多的真实需求，并最终把网络效应转化成商业价值。

Pendle 의 비전 - 모든 Yield 의 블랙홀

Yield 는 모든 금융에서 가장 중요한 도구이자, 돈이 움직이는 중심축 입니다.
Pendle 은 온체인 토큰 수익율을 다루는 V2 와 무기한 선물 펀딩비 마켓인 Boros 를 통해 온체인 세상의 모든 수익율을 흡수하겠다는 비전을 선포 하였습니다

Pendle 은 V2 와 Boros 를 통해 유저들에게 스테이블 코인, 토큰화 RWA, 무기한선물과 펀딩비에 대해 성향에 따라 베팅할 수 있는 기회를 열어주었고, 이를 통해 함께 성장해 왔습니다.

Wave1. Stablecoin

현재 스테이블 코인 공급량은 3천억달러 (전년대비 +14%)
Citi 는 2030 년까지 1.9조 달러 / SC는 28년 2조 달러 전망
Pendle 은 ETH 상 USDG 의 28% 보유, X Layer 에서는 체인 TVL 의 40% 가 Pendle USDG 마켓
Pendle Effect 로 스테이블 코인 수요 급증이 반복되고 있음

Wave2. Tokenized RWA

스테이블 제외 Tokenized RWA 는 현재 390억 달러로, 2년새 약 4배 성장
2030년 전망은 2~16조 달러 이상
올핸 출시된 Pendle 마켓 중 66개가 RWA 연계
Morpho RWA PT 2.1억 달러, STRC 마켓 5억달러, USDai 5.68억 달러 기록

'수익율 없는 자산도 PT/YT 화 할수 있는 기술 공개 예정'

Wave3. Perp and Funding Rate

Perp 의 남은 성장 영역은 주식/상품 연계. Ethena 와 같은 입장
Stock Perp OI 는 60억 달러로 6개월만에 10배 이상 성장, Hyperliquid Stock RWA 거래량은 올해 2120억 달러로, 50배 성장
다만, 펀딩비 변동성이 매우 큼. HL 가중 평균 연 14%, Binance 17.5%, 원유는 BTC 보다 14배 변동성이 크고, SKHynics 는 일일 펀딩 표준편차 163% 수준
Boros 는 펀딩비를 고정하건, 캐리트레이드/펀딩비 방향성 베팅을 가능케 함

text:
I was on a call today with a person building stablecoin payments on Solana, and I ended up giving him this advice.

He wanted feedback on his infra and the product. My answer to most of it was some version of "don't build that yet".

- You don't need to host all that infrastructure bare metal on your own end right now, lean on API providers and put the time into the core product
- Ship a focused version instead of sitting on features
- Start getting users, and start reaching out to people who are willing to take a bet on you
- Take social media seriously, people stick with products they're emotionally invested in, and that comes from having a storyline around what you're building

Building has gotten a lot easier in the last year or two with Claude and everything. Distribution is where the game is now, whether that comes from content, your personal reach or the product itself getting big.

The reason I kept pushing this is that I know the other side of it pretty well. I can keep building projects forever. But if I never put it out there nobody uses it, if nobody uses it it never gets battle-tested, and if it never gets battle-tested I have no metric or proof of anything. It just stays a side project.

That's a big part of why Zerith Studio runs a consultancy alongside a product studio, and why Proof of Profit only started feeling like a real product once people were actually paying for it during the FIFA World Cup.

So, what's the one thing you've been building for too long without putting it out?

text:
给跟着这条用 ChatGPT + MCPX 的朋友补个后续。

这两天遇到了几个问题：一直等不到回复、提示连接失败，有时换个对话也没解决。

我这边已经修好，可以继续干活了。几个经验分享给同样这样用的人：

1. 提示超时，不代表刚才的任务没做。

可能只是回复没回来，电脑上的任务还在跑。这时候连续催它“再来一次”，反而可能把同一件事做两遍。先查进度和结果。

2. 它说“连接断了”，先做个小检查。

让它读一下当前项目里的一个小文件，看看实际能不能访问。别一上来就重装、重新配置，把问题越搞越复杂。

3. 换对话、换模型接手，先核对之前做到了哪。

哪些文件已经改过、任务还在不在运行、有没有结果，先看清楚再继续。

这次排查还发现，自动重试、自动重启也会帮倒忙。我把这些处理调整后，再实际调用确认恢复。

以后卡住，可以直接把这段话丢给 AI：

“先不要重跑刚才的任务。做一次简单的只读检查，确认能否访问当前项目；能访问的话，检查上一项任务是否还在运行、是否已有结果。不能访问就告诉我具体报错，先不要重装或清理。”

quoted_text:
上个月我发过这条：ChatGPT 网页聊天和 Codex 是两块分开的额度。

但当时我只跑通了一个很笨的办法：

Codex 打包任务 → 我手动丢给网页 ChatGPT → 它做完 → 再搬回本地编译测试。

它证明了 Chat 里确实还有另一桶额度，却没有真正解决问题：ChatGPT 自己碰不到电脑，派发、搬运和验收仍然要靠 Codex，交接本身继续烧 Codex 额度。

今天这个缺口终于补上了。

现在 Codex / Work 的额度用完后，我可以直接在普通 ChatGPT 聊天窗口里，让它继续操作本地电脑干活：

- 读本地文件
- 改文件
- 跑命令
- 跑测试
- 验证结果

这条链路走的是 Chat 这边的可用额度，不需要再把代码和结果人工搬来搬去。

这个想法来自两条线索。

昨天另一条额度帖的评论区里，@studyouwei 提到：他用 DevSpace 把本地目录接到了 ChatGPT Chat，相当于用 Chat 的额度搞 coding。

差不多同一时间，微信群里有群友提到了 MCPX。

我把两条线索合起来，自己跑了一遍。通了。

最小实现是：

1. 在自己的电脑上运行 MCPX，只登记准备交给 AI 工作的项目目录
2. 给本地 MCPX 配一个 HTTPS + 鉴权的 Remote MCP 入口，不要裸开端口
3. 在 ChatGPT 设置里创建或启用 custom MCP app
4. 绑定 Workspace；需要跨聊天持续接力，再使用 Remote Session
5. 回到普通 ChatGPT 对话，直接让它 read / edit / execute / verify

这篇稿子本身，就是用这条链路完成的。

它在这个普通 ChatGPT 对话里回查旧帖和旧视频、更新本地稿件、再跑验证。不是演示，是真的在继续工作。

照抄之前，先看三个边界：

第一，先确认你的 ChatGPT 设置里有没有 custom MCP 入口。不同账户和 rollout 可能不一样。

第二，Workspace 约束的是文件工具，不代表 execute 天然只能看这个目录。命令权限要单独卡。

第三，公网入口必须有 HTTPS 和鉴权。资金、账号、凭证、公开发布、部署、生产等动作，继续单独确认。

所以这次和上个月最大的区别很简单：

上次只是发现 Chat 里还有一桶额度。
这次终于把这桶额度接到了电脑上，能直接完成真实工作。

Codex / Work 额度用完后，不一定只能买号或者等重置。

至少现在，我还能换到普通 ChatGPT 对话里，接着干。

quoted_text:
More people should know about the Interfold.

It's basically what I've been yelling at people to build with the MACI ideas ( https://t.co/mlDy84zXQo ) for almost a decade, and now it exists, in a generalized form.

The idea is: a privacy protocol optimized for things like voting (and other use cases eg. secret-ballot auctions). The mechanism generates a threshold encryption key, and people send in their votes onchain, using a ZKP to prove eligibility. An arbitrary computation on the votes gets run inside FHE, and then threshold-decrypted.

From what I can tell (the docs are good https://t.co/adzwK6ezMN ), it gets pretty optimal security guarantees:

* Voter anonymity can be made unconditional if eligibility is proven with ZK-SNARKs
* Censorship resistance is guaranteed by ethereum (votes can be posted directly onchain, and there's a proof that all posted votes are taking into account)
* The correctness of the outputted result can be ensured via ZK over FHE
* Liveness and coercion resistance depend on M-of-N honesty; unavoidable given present-day technology

The main limitation is that today "ZK over FHE" is only properly available for additive vote tallying, as it's too expensive for computations that involve multiplication or other more complicated manipulation at the moment. There's work in progress on slashing-based / optimistic computation for such situations.

(And of course ideally in the long term we'd figure out obfuscation so you can get rid of the M-of-N committees😃)

-both platforms have egalitarian insider-free fully distributed fair launches, with amazing buyback/burn and strong revenue (stonk, pons, LONG (indirectly))

timeline has been like this:

RH chain innovated a new set of memecoin primitives (memefi), and a ton of people during the depths of the bear (or early bull) bridged over from solana (94% of capital, initially, came from sol). it was the first beneficiary of the liquidity from that first BTC impulse up after the bessent YCC tweet.

solana said "hey, we've got stonk fun - you can come back now, and do this at home. and we have some cool sort of symbiotic PVE token design we're playing with too" and many people bridged back (pons/RH chain stuff cooled off a bit here after an amazing run)

all of onchain on all platforms cooled off past ~2 days

a certain platform launched an (alleged) coordinated FUD campaign against stonk fun

RH teased announcements, RH incumbents said "ok come back now" to appeal to the rotational mercenary cohort that's comfortable moving back and forth to try to time oscillations

but shockingly

both platforms/ecos are pumping the past hour or two, together. and while i don't think they always do well concurrently, i think stonk fun and RH chain will kinda leapfrog each other, bullishly, and both end up with amazing winners at extravagant mcaps by the end of this cycle.

i think what drives price appreciation for stonk/RH:

1) capital from sideliners/cryptonatives redeploying
2) net new capital from a new wave of folks (seeing early signs of this, if you look at social signals). apps will do a lot of heavy lifting here, having solved consumer-grade UX for the first time
3) bloated reactionary/complacent incumbents that were capitalized in a previous market under very different assumptions about today's competitive landscape will continue to see outflows that flow into newer, hungrier, feature-rich platforms that ship high-PMF features aggressively, alongside a more friendly and inclusive, above-board culture.

Bitcoin is pumping, but US spot demand still isn’t confirming the move.

The Coinbase Premium is back below 0, meaning BTC trades slightly cheaper on Coinbase than on Binance.

That doesn’t guarantee a retrace, but without stronger spot buying, the rally could be easier for perp traders to fade.

IMO, 3 things need to happen:

1. The Coinbase Premium needs to reclaim zero.
2. It needs to remain positive, not just briefly cross above it.
3. Ideally, it should rise alongside BTC, showing that Coinbase buyers are supporting the move.

The rally can continue without this, but a sustained positive premium would make it much more convincing.

For now, I’m watching to see whether US spot demand catches up with the price.

Been holding and mentioning $MONEY for some time now, but never shared my thesis. 
So here it is:

I feel like they did something really unique to stablecoins, and very in-line with the current meta. 

Until now, stablecoins like USDC and USDT were backed mostly by US Treasuries and cash held by the issuer.

The yield on those reserves? It goes to Circle and Tether. You only get a dollar that sits still.

What if your dollar was backed by the S&P 500, and the upside stayed with you?

That's what Own is building.

Deposit eSPY (a token tracking the S&P 500, backed 1:1 by real tokenized stock in a protocol-owned reserve). Mint eUSD against it at 150% collateral. Keep every bit of upside on your stocks while you spend, trade, or farm with the dollars.

Important, the peg isn't just a promise. Any holder can redeem 1 eUSD for exactly $1 of eSPY. 

And they built in an amazing flywheel for their protocol token $MONEY:

Stake eUSD and you earn yield paid from $MONEY trading fees. 

Hold $MONEY and you boost that yield.

That's where it gets interesting. Normally, more stakers means a thinner APR for everyone. Here, it's the feature instead of the bug:

More eUSD staked → more $MONEY needed to max the boost → more $MONEY buying and volume → more trading fees → APR climbs back up → more people mint and stake eUSD.

Wall Street built the world's best collateral.
DeFi built the world's best money rails.
Own is plugging one into the other.

Think this coin can do very well during the next leg up of the Robinhood eco.

text:
It would be helpful when you frame the question in the future to point to what exactly you think is bad about the current setup, instead of just constantly saying “two dozen validators in tokyo” in these tweets as if it’s a given that such a thing is the literal spawn of satan (and then forcing us to assume your own argument for you)

Is it the two dozen part? Well clearly that’s not a problem for regulators because finance today is run on highly centralized venues. There isn’t an obvious principle under which financial infrastructure becomes legally acceptable only after some minimum number of independent consensus participants. 

Is it the tokyo part? I sort of see your view there, but again, blockchains are fundamentally transparent technologies where the location of your validators shouldn’t matter for auditing purposes. I mean, there are American companies that are validators on Hyperliquid. The actual compliant market operators on Hyperliquid will be U.S. licensed companies. So I’m not sure what’s left besides imaginary scenarios where the Japanese government decides to go after Hyperliquid and we can’t stop them, but who cares? We don’t stop American companies from sourcing from TSMC because China can invade Taiwan. Just spin up a new set of validators in the U.S. if it happens. Isn’t this what’s cool about blockchains in the first place - that finance can become truly borderless? 

Finally, I think investing on the basis that everyone else in the world will hold themselves to your own principles and worldviews is just a bad way to invest. If you can’t see that regulators clearly don’t seem to care as much as you do, idk what to tell ya. This thing is going to happen, and it’s going to happen soon.  I just don’t think there’s an incentive for the CFTC and SEC to give a shit, if it’s what the people and president want and it’s what brings a great American entrepreneur home. This shit is really just about incentives at the end of the day, just like you’re incentivized to say this as a Solana stakeholder and I’m incentivized to say this as a HYPE stakeholder. 

Respect your thoughts as always though, which is why I choose to respond.

于是把近几年的跑会TIPS放在这里！给今年来新加坡、尤其是第一次来的朋友，少走一点弯路👇

1️⃣ 先把几天的重要安排记住

▪️10 月 6 日：OKX Now
▪️10 月 7–8 日：TOKEN2049 主会，滨海湾金沙
▪️10 月 9–11 日：F1 新加坡站

这几天都按新加坡当地时间，和北京、香港没有时差

主会门票、Side Event 报名、OKX Now 邀请、F1 门票，不能通用。申请提交，不等于审核通过，出发前记得检查确认邮件

2️⃣ OKX Now

10 月 6 日，从上午的产品发布和现场演示，到下午的行业对话

期待和大家面对面聊聊，也想听听你们看完产品后的真实反馈💚

提醒一下：OKX Now 是邀请制，只有获确认的嘉宾才能参加。收到海报或提交申请，不等于已经完成入场确认

受邀的朋友，提前和邀请人核对好时间、地址及签到方式

酒店名字也要看清：Pan Pacific Orchard，不是 Pan Pacific Singapore

别跑错了😂 具体入场信息以确认邀请为准

⚠️活动有地区适用限制，详见官方活动说明 https://t.co/qY1ybeK9T6。不能到现场的朋友，也欢迎关注官方直播～

3️⃣ 去看 F1，听我一句劝：尽量坐地铁！

比赛期间周边封路、绕行，坐 MRT 通常更省心。先看门票对应的入场口，再选下车站，不是所有人都去同一个站

而且相关封路安排从 10 月 7 日就开始了，主会期间也会影响部分滨海湾周边交通

💡地铁支付提前准备好：

▫️带非接触支付标志、符合要求的 Visa／Mastercard，可以直接刷

▫️或者买 EZ-Link 交通卡

▫️微信、支付宝付款码不能直接当作这里的地铁乘车码

▫️进出站用同一张卡或同一台手机，别进去刷手机、出来换实体卡

去 TOKEN2049 主会场，地铁认准 Bayfront 站，不是 Marina Bay 站；

打车直接搜 Sands Expo & Convention Centre，不要只填「金沙酒店」

4️⃣ Side Event 不用报满，先想清楚自己想见谁

找活动可以收藏这张 @punk2898  做的中文地图：https://t.co/0isEbrvjoV

先定当天最想去的一两场，再找附近顺路的活动。地图帮你找线索，最终时间、费用、地址和入场要求，还是看主办方原页面

也不用把社交全部安排在晚上。晨跑、早餐会、咖啡局、Workshop，都可以认识人。

5️⃣ 住哪里

▫️乌节路附近活动多：优先看 Orchard 一带。
▫️主会安排满：优先考虑去金沙方便的位置。
▫️想兼顾预算和交通：可以看看 Bugis、Bencoolen、Chinatown，具体看酒店离地铁多远。

订房之前可以多看一眼含税总价、取消政策、有没有窗、是不是独立卫浴，以及到地铁实际要走多远。房费省下来的钱，别最后都花在打车上😂

退房当天还要继续跑会的话，提前问好酒店能不能寄存行李，给取行李和去机场留够时间

6️⃣ 吃饭可以简单，约饭尽量提前

想吃本地餐食、控制预算，可以把 Maxwell、牛车水大厦熟食中心、老巴刹放进备选。早餐找顺路的亚坤，正餐也可以考虑松发

想吃辣椒蟹，就提前订位、问清重量和价格，不要夹在两场会议之间赶着吃

餐厅标价后面如果有“++”，记得看服务费和税。比如收取 10% 服务费和 9% GST 时，标价 S$100，最后是 S$119.90

熟食中心吃完记得收好托盘、餐具和桌面垃圾

7️⃣ 最后：出发前检查清单

□ SG Arrival Card：抵达前的三天内提交，包含抵达当天。ICA 官方渠道免费，免签不等于不用填

□ 手机卡：有流量不一定能打电话、收短信，原手机号记得保留接验证码的能力

□ 支付：可用的银行卡＋少量新币现金，留个备用 

□ 随身带：薄外套、雨具、充电宝、好走路的鞋 

□ 入场凭证：提前存好，晒图记得打码 

□ 约见地址：写清哪家酒店、哪一层、哪个入口

如果晚上正好在金沙附近，也可以留点时间看水舞秀，或者去滨海湾花园看灯光。但是需要留意当天开放和交通安排嗷！

前两次 TOKEN 留下的回忆都太特别，希望这一次，见到想见的人，留下的都是开心

10 月，大家，新加坡见！

text:
在ETHShanghai上有朋友问主任怎么看以太坊的技术方向和价值捕获：

技术上隐私，抗量子，账户抽象，AI Agent infra都是很好的补全和为未来做准备，在激发个体创造力上略微缺乏想象力。

价值捕获上目前的局面就比较糟糕，长期以来，以太坊的技术范式催生的商业模式大量地被有商业力量的主体以L2或者弱中心化EVM Chain的方式在稀释。

交易所而言，L2/EVM链是CEX的去中心化事业部，Robinhood，Coinbase,Binance, Okx等等, 对稳定币来说，公链是分销稳定币的工具，Tether和Circle都有各自或深或浅绑定发展的公链，还有一些超级应用如预测市场, RWA和永续合约都选择起盘独立的基建。

在行业经历了几个周期的发展后，一旦某种商业模式被验证，就会快速被各类商业主体在自身的“去中心化”基建上快速复制，而这些主体永远在技术上第一时间和ETH对齐，但很少会在经济，技术和人才上回馈ETH，稳定币，Defi, NFT, Meme, RWA 各类商业生态不断上演创新-复制-稀释的这个循环。

text: Justlend @DeFi_JUST
author: sunyuchentron
quoted_text:
JustLend从众多借贷协议中脱颖而出，6年0安全事故

晚上看了一圈主流借贷协议，Aave在做多链规模，Morpho走模块化和隔离市场，Compound继续做基础借贷，Venus则深耕BNB Chain。

JustLend 它没有追求覆盖多少条链，而是围绕TRON生态，把借贷、稳定币、质押和Energy需求慢慢串了起来。

目前 JustLend TVL约 38.4亿美元。今年一季度约33亿美元，阶段增长约16%。对于一个主要聚焦单一公链的借贷协议来说，这个资金体量已经相当可观。

1、和主流借贷协议相比，JustLend的特点是什么？

简单看一下目前几家头部协议数据上，Aave和Morpho的整体规模更大，这是多链模式带来的结果。

但JustLend比较特别的一点是：38亿美元左右的TVL，主要集中在TRON这一条链上。

这意味着它的增长逻辑并不是不断去新的公链抢流动性，而是继续吃深TRON本身的稳定币和链上资金需求。

2、JST比较值得看的，其实是价值回流

价格目前约 0.113美元，季度以来上涨约31%，而且目前已经完成三轮销毁累计约 13.56亿JST，回购资金主要来自协议净收入。

此前累积收入的30%用于首轮执行，其余70%计划在2026年按季度释放，后续新增净收入也会进入下一季度回购池。

还有一个细节比较有意思，暂未使用的资金会进入JustLend的USDT市场获取收益，再用于后续回购。

协议产生收入 → 回购JST → JST进入销毁 → 流通供应减少。

这也是JustLend和单纯依靠治理预期的DeFi代币比较明显的区别。

3、JustLend现在已经不只是借贷

目前除了传统借贷，还包括 sTRX流动性质押、Energy租赁、清算工具和DAO治理。

V2则进一步引入了隔离市场、ERC-4626金库以及自适应利率模型，把不同市场的风险进行隔离。

目前协议包含18个活跃市场以及6个历史市场。

1 / TRON上有大量USDT转账需求，就会产生Energy需求
2 / 有稳定币流动性，就会产生借贷需求
3 / 有TRX质押需求，又会产生sTRX等产品。

所以JustLend并不是单独做一个借贷协议，而是在围绕TRON本身的链上需求搭产品。

4、收益率不是重点，资金和场景才是

目前JustLend的USDT基础供应年化大约2%，USDD市场综合收益最高约6.5%。

Aave、Morpho等协议部分稳定币市场的收益也能达到类似水平，而且APY会随着资金利用率和激励不断变化。

TRON上的稳定币规模、USDT转账需求，以及Energy市场，本身就是天然的使用场景。

5、最终还是看能不能形成闭环

Aave的优势是多链和成熟的流动性市场，Morpho更强调模块化和市场自由度，Compound走的是相对简洁的基础借贷路线。

JustLend则是稳定币资金 → 借贷市场 → 协议收入 → JST回购销毁 → 再反哺生态。

再叠加sTRX和Energy租赁，借贷只是其中一个入口。

所以我认为判断JustLend不能只盯着它和Aave差多少TVL。更值得看的，是它能不能继续把TRON上的真实链上需求转化成协议收入，再进一步形成JST的价值回流。

这可能才是JustLend这几年真正想走出来的一条路。

And Polymarket just quietly became one of the most visited financial information sites on the internet.

Think about what actually changed.

People didn't stop wanting to know what's happening in the world. They stopped trusting the packaging it came in. Headlines written to maximize outrage. Predictions with no accountability. Pundits who are wrong every election cycle and are back on TV the next morning anyway.

Polymarket does something news can't.

It puts a price on the prediction. A journalist can say "markets are nervous about the Fed" with zero consequences if they're wrong. A Polymarket trader who says the same thing with $50,000 behind it has real skin in the game.

That accountability is what 28% of news readers went looking for and couldn't find.

The numbers back it up. Fed rate decision markets on Polymarket regularly hit $7 million plus in volume. Election markets crossed $3.5 billion in 2024. The Israel ceasefire market hit $2.1 million. People are not just reading these markets. They're treating them as the most honest real time signal available.

The legacy news model was built on scarcity of information. They had the reporters, the sources, the printing press. You needed them.

That scarcity is gone. And 28% of their audience already left.

The next 28% won't be reading less news. They'll be reading the price.

And before they place a single dollar they'll want to know exactly what they make if they're right.

1/ gm. gm. Name is Hsin-Ju.
I have a dark, kinda tragic personal announcement.

I've decided I'd rather take $0 than accept a settlement that requires me to stay silent about what happened to me. I have since fired my lawyers at @sanfordheisler & will be releasing all the evidence from my time @hack_vc on Wed 8/26.

INTRO: I've been in crypto for 9 years. Most recently I was a partner & head of platform @hack_vc which is a $600-700M crypto VC firm. Many of you may know me from my time as Head of Growth at @StellarOrg in 2017 (worked w/ the Mt. Gox founder), @Solana in 2018 (joined under ~10 ppl, but quit before my cliff), & @Fhenix in 2024. Or have attended one of my @DystopiaLabs ETH events (2019-now).

Last year, I was forced to work through a serious medical emergency while at @Hack_VC due to threats by @alpackaP @dbulaevsky, saying that they would blacklist me from the space if I quit before finishing the hacksummit conference & side events that I was helping with during @kbwofficial. I was working 13-14hr days, 6 days a week, sleeping 0-4 hrs a night, and had documented Graves' disease, hyperthyroidism, and severe insomnia. I repeatedly asked to quit. Hack VC refused. This + other threats and intimidation went on for almost a month.

The conditions got so bad I attempted suicide.

The fucked up part is that, even after the suicide attempt, I told everyone at Hack VC (in writing) that I had no plans to sue. I was scared & extremely sick. I just wanted to leave. I told them that as long as there was no retaliation or badmouthing - I had no plans to sue.

@Hack_VC chose to retaliate.

After just 1 month after my near suicide, Hack VC mishandled my COBRA health insurance, refused to fix things, kept shooing me to customer support (when it's legally Hack VC's responsibility to fix this), and my insurance had issues and was not fixed for almost 4 MONTHS. Hack VC did not fix everything until I hired lawyers and had them force Hack VC to adhere to the law & fix my COBRA insurance issues. The sheer cruelty of an employer harming someone's health insurance almost immediately after they nearly committed suicide is extremely fucked up.

And, even during the legal engagement, Hack VC continued to lie & attempt to harm me through their lawyers and other employees/partners (multi-million dollar carry & clawbacks can make even the nicest ppl willing to turn the other way or lie). @0xRodney @IsTheBaron @roshunpatel @Alex__Botte.

Now. Almost an entire year of engagement & my near suicide anniversary coming up, our lawyers (mine & Hack VC's) have reached the point of preparing for private mediation and settlement. And...I realized that I just can't do it. I don't want money in exchange for silence. I'd rather speak. 

I fired my lawyers yesterday.

In case it needs to be said, I did a good job at Hack VC. I was only there full time for 7 months; been part-time since 2021. I got a $50k raise to $300k, $30k bonus, and promises of additional carry that would have been implemented about a week or so after my last day. I was also offered admission into the GP entity (but not sure if admission was actually completed bc it was during my medical emergency). This + my resume, should show that me suing is not a money grab; I was genuinely harmed.

I'm aware that I'm just one person (who is not rich) facing a $600-700M VC institution. I've been told by @alpackaP that he's known most of the managing partners at most VC firms for almost a decade and he could absolutely blacklist me. 
 
 I'm also painful aware that the conclusion of this will probably be extremely poor for me or death - but I've accepted it. 
 
 Sharing with other web2 & web3 VCs: 
@paulg @ycombinator @500STARTUPS @a16zcrypto @PanteraCapital @dragonflyvc @RaceCapital @hosseeb @haunventures @hiFramework @ElectricCapital @blockchaincap @Delphi_Digital @variantfund @1kxnetwork @archetypevc @shimacapital @robotventures, etc.

TLDR; I’m done with continued threats, pressure, and intimidation. I'm not going to take a payout and allow Alex or Hack VC to walk away from harming me. As mentioned, I'll be dropping the evidence from my case on Wed 8/26 (or before) -- privacy be damned.

Support here (or DM) please:

Claude Opus 5.5 [xhigh] on KernelBench-Mega:

It made a Kimi-Linear Decode megakernel for RTX PRO 6000 at 35.5x the optimized PyTorch baseline! (the 2nd best was GPT-6 Astra at 24.8x)

A few words from me (performance engineer):

Before we get into the weeds here on how it hillclimbed, its clear to me this is a massive jump over fable and maybe astra too. They supposedly "nerfed" it on kernels but I suspect just TPU and/or Trainium rather than CUDA. The writing style increases my productivity a ton as I don't need that many seconds to understand the blocker or status its facing (im running 20 of these in parallel btw so human attention is scarce). It also takes agency rather than waiting for me. I think this is because at some deep level with mech interp/finetuning, they cracked how to understand the users intent so deeply that its fine executing on the task that the user would say "go" constantly. This means YOU can parallelize more as well. Oh also its cheap and fast and thats just great. S+ tier release imo.

---

The climbs look different from the start. Opus 5.5's first working megakernel was already 21x at 31 minutes. Astra's first was 14x at one hour, and it spent the next four hours inching from 24 to 25. Fable 5.1 got to 23x in two hours before the session died on an API error.

One session each on my RTX PRO 6000 rig, unlimited budget. The numbers are isolated regrades after a jsonl trace-level and submission-level reward-hack audit.

author: kugusha
quoted_text:
I’ve been asked a lot what it’s like to partner with both Coinbase and Robinhood when they compete so fiercely.

The answer comes down to Morpho’s fundamental purpose: connecting.

Morpho is an open credit network designed to connect lenders and borrowers across any boundary (social, geographic, political, …). More borrowers create more demand for capital. More lenders create more competition to fund borrowers. Over time, that means deeper liquidity and better terms for everyone using the Morpho network.

Competitors sharing infrastructure isn’t unique to Morpho. Banks compete fiercely for customers while relying on shared payment networks like Visa. Tech companies compete while building on the same internet protocols like HTTP. Credit should work the same way: it works better when you are maximally connected.

Our ambition is to bring as much of the world's credit onto one shared network as possible. If you’re building on Morpho, expect us to keep connecting new companies, new markets, new ecosystems, including the ones you compete with, because this is what will make your financial products stronger!

text:
我越来越确信一件事。
未来链上爆款应用的公式，就是“链抽象 + X”

链抽象本身不是产品，只是一种属性。
而 X 可以是 meme 交易、永续合约，也可以是社交。这些需求早就被验证过了，缺的只是把用户摩擦系数降到最低。
谁先做到这一点，谁就能拿走这一轮的用户。

FOMO 就是最典型的例子。它没有创造新需求，只是把旧需求做成了感觉不到链的样子。

但如果这个判断成立，真正的长远赢家不该是 FOMO 这类应用，而是所有应用脚下的两层基础设施：
▌@RelayProtocol 跨链结算与路由层
▌@privy_io 面向开发者的钱包与账户基础设施

逻辑和淘金潮一样。
应用层迭代极快，今天的 FOMO 明天就可能被更好的 App 取代，但每一个应用都绕不开同样两道关卡：跨链要结算，账户要托管。
应用层的赢家是概率题，卖铲人的收入是确定项。

此外离谱的是，从 FOMO 到 Relay 再到 Privy，背后都有同一批资方的身影。
Relay 与 FOMO 的共同资方： Archetype、Coinbase 与 USV
三者的共同资方： Coinbase、Archetype

只能说，世界是个巨大的山东。

FOMO 传送 - https://t.co/WN2bCgxeck

quoted_text:
JustLend从众多借贷协议中脱颖而出，6年0安全事故

晚上看了一圈主流借贷协议，Aave在做多链规模，Morpho走模块化和隔离市场，Compound继续做基础借贷，Venus则深耕BNB Chain。

JustLend 它没有追求覆盖多少条链，而是围绕TRON生态，把借贷、稳定币、质押和Energy需求慢慢串了起来。

目前 JustLend TVL约 38.4亿美元。今年一季度约33亿美元，阶段增长约16%。对于一个主要聚焦单一公链的借贷协议来说，这个资金体量已经相当可观。

1、和主流借贷协议相比，JustLend的特点是什么？

简单看一下目前几家头部协议数据上，Aave和Morpho的整体规模更大，这是多链模式带来的结果。

但JustLend比较特别的一点是：38亿美元左右的TVL，主要集中在TRON这一条链上。

这意味着它的增长逻辑并不是不断去新的公链抢流动性，而是继续吃深TRON本身的稳定币和链上资金需求。

2、JST比较值得看的，其实是价值回流

价格目前约 0.113美元，季度以来上涨约31%，而且目前已经完成三轮销毁累计约 13.56亿JST，回购资金主要来自协议净收入。

此前累积收入的30%用于首轮执行，其余70%计划在2026年按季度释放，后续新增净收入也会进入下一季度回购池。

还有一个细节比较有意思，暂未使用的资金会进入JustLend的USDT市场获取收益，再用于后续回购。

协议产生收入 → 回购JST → JST进入销毁 → 流通供应减少。

这也是JustLend和单纯依靠治理预期的DeFi代币比较明显的区别。

3、JustLend现在已经不只是借贷

目前除了传统借贷，还包括 sTRX流动性质押、Energy租赁、清算工具和DAO治理。

V2则进一步引入了隔离市场、ERC-4626金库以及自适应利率模型，把不同市场的风险进行隔离。

目前协议包含18个活跃市场以及6个历史市场。

1 / TRON上有大量USDT转账需求，就会产生Energy需求
2 / 有稳定币流动性，就会产生借贷需求
3 / 有TRX质押需求，又会产生sTRX等产品。

所以JustLend并不是单独做一个借贷协议，而是在围绕TRON本身的链上需求搭产品。

4、收益率不是重点，资金和场景才是

目前JustLend的USDT基础供应年化大约2%，USDD市场综合收益最高约6.5%。

Aave、Morpho等协议部分稳定币市场的收益也能达到类似水平，而且APY会随着资金利用率和激励不断变化。

TRON上的稳定币规模、USDT转账需求，以及Energy市场，本身就是天然的使用场景。

5、最终还是看能不能形成闭环

Aave的优势是多链和成熟的流动性市场，Morpho更强调模块化和市场自由度，Compound走的是相对简洁的基础借贷路线。

JustLend则是稳定币资金 → 借贷市场 → 协议收入 → JST回购销毁 → 再反哺生态。

再叠加sTRX和Energy租赁，借贷只是其中一个入口。

所以我认为判断JustLend不能只盯着它和Aave差多少TVL。更值得看的，是它能不能继续把TRON上的真实链上需求转化成协议收入，再进一步形成JST的价值回流。

这可能才是JustLend这几年真正想走出来的一条路。

text:
美国欠了40万亿美元+，比特币为什么越来越重要？（视频来自 @jackmallers ）

美国国债刚刚来到约40.1万亿美元。这个数字太大，大到普通人已经没感觉了。

我们来拿黄金对比一下，现在黄金约4329美元/盎司，人类历史上开采出来的黄金大约22.26万吨，全部按今天价格算，也就约31万亿美元。

也就是说，把人类几千年挖出来的黄金全部卖掉，甚至还不够覆盖美国一家的国债。

更夸张的是美国自己手里的黄金，美国官方持有约2.615亿盎司黄金，按现在市价大约1.13万亿美元，只相当于40.1万亿国债的2.8%左右。

真正的问题在于这台机器现在每年还在继续加杠杆。

CBO预计2026财年美国赤字约1.9万亿美元，净利息支出已经超过1万亿美元，债务利息占GDP约3.3%，到2036年预计升到4.6%。

所以美国面对的是未来很长时间都要在增长、加税、削减支出、通胀和实际利率之间找平衡。

只要名义债务长期跑得比真实经济快，持有现金的人就在承担这套体系的另一面。

这才是我觉得比特币重要的地方。

BTC是这个世界需要一种不能被任何政府继续增发的资产。2100万枚上限、全球流通、没有主权发行人，也不需要谁承诺未来偿还你。

短期高利率、流动性收紧照样可以把比特币砸下来，但把时间拉长，当法币体系里的债权不断膨胀，稀缺资产就会越来越像一把尺。

40万亿美元不是比特币一定上涨的理由。

但越来越多人开始问一句话的理由：

到底应该用美元衡量比特币，还是有一天，我们会开始用比特币衡量美元。

text:
有朋友问，为什么最近Alpha School在硅谷这么火？

我自己对新学校的研究不多，以前也没怎么注意。后来问了一下周围的家长，确实如此，都在谈论要不要送孩子去。

然后我做了 一下research。Alpha在Palo Alto的校区比较新，在旧金山和东湾也有校区。Palo Alto校区的学费是一年七万五千美元。它的承诺说起来很简单：每天早上两个小时，用AI自适应软件学完核心学科，下午去做项目、运动，学公开演讲、编程、创业这些生活技能。今年秋天它要扩到大约五十个校区，CEO Joe Liemandt说，他想触达十亿个孩子。

它最近这么火，我觉得有三个原因。

最直接的，是它替家长解开了一个死结。家长一边怕孩子学得不够，一边又怕童年被课业占满，这两件事平时只能二选一。Alpha说，不用选，先把学习效率提上去，再把一天重新安排。这句话打动人的地方不在用AI，而是孩子每天会怎么过。

另一个原因，是它说的正是硅谷自己的语言。传统学校讲历史、师资、升学率，Alpha讲个性化、即时反馈、可测量的进步，它最醒目的那个数字，是学生在MAP测试上的成长速度平均达到同龄人的2.6倍。我前面在文化沙漠那篇里引过Paul Graham那句话，让增长率替你做所有决定。这一次，这套逻辑漫到了孩子身上。

还有一层是焦虑。这里的很多家长每天都在看AI改变自己的工作，很自然地会问，孩子还要按老路去准备一个已经在变化中的未来吗？选Alpha，某种程度上是在押注一种新的活法。

所以我承认，它切中的痛点是真的。我在压缩学制那篇里说过，一个班的进度实际上是所有人的最慢速度，AI最该砍掉的就是等待和重复。Alpha在这一点上砍得很干脆，这部分我觉得很有道理。

问题在于，它到底砍出了什么，现在还说不清。2.6倍是校方自己公布的，《科学美国人》8月的报道说，Alpha一直没有公开支撑这些主张的底层数据。它今年2月发布的年中成绩单，是校长把MAP数据交给Gemini和Claude分析，再把两个模型的解读贴出来，这不是独立研究。七万五千美元的学费也意味着，孩子的家庭背景、成人投入和各种资源都跟软件搅在一起，分不出哪一份进步是AI的。

最有意思的是，我在压缩学制那篇里引过一项哈佛物理课的随机对照实验，这次《科学美国人》采访的，正好有那项研究的两位作者。Greg Kestin担心孩子在AI辅导的环境里表现很好，但换个地方就用不出来，他管这叫脆弱的知识；Kelly Miller说，好的辅导和好的教学不是一回事。我在那篇里也写过，真正该测的是三样：能不能长期保留，能不能迁移到陌生的问题上，本人能不能解释和修正自己的判断。几个月的测验成长率，这三个问题一个都回答不了。

再深挖一点，也是我最在意的地方。Alpha给了孩子自己的速度，没有给孩子自己的目的。按自己的节奏完成别人定好的任务，跟参与决定什么值得学，是两种完全不同的自主。它的下午排的是二十四项生活技能，公开演讲、编程、创业、户外，这些都不坏，但它仍然是一张别人列好的清单。

我在压缩学制那篇的结尾写过，省下来的时间如果变成一个人的选择空间，那才是压缩的意义；如果只是换了一个更苛刻的计时器，那就什么都没改。Alpha现在正站在这两条路的岔口上。

它之所以火，是因为它把硅谷最相信的那套东西，直接用到了孩子身上，还配上了家长最想听的那句承诺。但我依然坚持进度条可以交给软件，“为了什么”还得留给孩子自己。

又一个噩耗传来，拥有 9 年行业资历的前 Hack VC 合伙人，早期 Solana 增长负责人 Hsin-Ju Chuang 不幸离去。

但整件事的时间线看下来充斥着令人不安的疑云，更像是一桩离奇命案：

-8 月 23 日，她公开发文与老东家决裂，称宁可拿 0 美元也绝不签封口协议，指控自己在患重病期间遭强制超时工作、封杀威胁及医保断缴，并明确预告将在 8 月 26 日公开所有证据。
而这个原文里她自己提到：“The conditions got so bad I attempted suicide.”（自杀未遂）

-发文次日（8 月 24 日晚），她就被发现死在加州莫哈韦沙漠的公路匝道旁，年仅 37 岁。

-死因至今未明，但这个消息竟在圈内悄无声息地躺了整整 30 天，直到今天同行转发悼念才浮出水面。

这很难不让人联想起之前 8 月初坠亡的另一起迷案：

深度绑定 Fantom 生态、掌管巨额资金的巨鲸 Harry Yeh，在巴拉圭豪华公寓 30 楼赤裸坠亡，屋内被翻得凌乱不堪。

短短一个月内，一位是自述不堪重负的老兵离奇暴毙，一位是手握数亿资产的链上巨鲸疑似遭暴力清算。

愿逝者得以安息，也愿每一个还在这个残酷周期里跋涉的生者，不仅能穿越牛熊，更能守住身心的健康与平安。

在任何浮盈与成就面前，好好活着，才是真正的硬道理。

text:
Most people know Axis from controlling robot arms in a browser.

But @axisrobotics is now going after another source of Physical AI data:

You.

Not your clicks. Your actual movements.

This is the part of the Axis stack I hadn't paid enough attention to before: the Mobile Egocentric App.

Instead of only collecting robot trajectories inside simulation, Axis can capture how humans actually perform tasks in the real world from a first-person perspective.

The setup can range from something as accessible as an iPhone to:

→ multi-camera headbands
→ wrist cameras
→ optional grippers
→ everyday + industrial environments

But raw video isn't the end product.

Axis processes that human activity into structured data by reconstructing 4D hand motion and pairing it with language + subtask annotations.

Basically:

Human performs a task
→ first-person activity is captured
→ hand movement is reconstructed
→ actions are segmented + annotated
→ raw activity becomes model-ready data

And this is where it gets interesting.

Simulation gives Axis scale, controlled environments and the ability to generate huge variations of the same task.

Egocentric collection gives it something different: the diversity and messiness of how humans actually interact with the real world.

Axis isn't choosing one over the other.

It's building both into the same data engine.

Sim data + human activity data → processing → model training → deployment → failures → new data requirements.

Then the loop starts again.

If you want to start contributing to Axis yourself:
https://t.co/EPnmS2s501

Just remember to sign completed trajectories onchain referred trajectories only count toward the Kaito multiplier once they're verified and signed.

I think this matters because Physical AI probably won't be solved by one giant dataset from one source.

Robots need simulated experience.

But they also need examples of how humans actually move, manipulate and complete tasks in the wild.

Axis is trying to collect both.

text:
i’ve been back home for a few days, in the tiny italian town where i grew up. maybe 6,000 people.

yesterday i saw some old school friends i hadn’t seen in years and it was genuinely fascinating how little their lives have changed.

most people here don’t go to university. they finish school and start working right away.
then that’s kind of their life.

wake up, work as an electrician or mechanic, come home, watch football, beer with friends on friday. work all year, save enough money for a week of vacation in august, come back and repeat.

most have basically no idea what AI is. all the things that feel world-changing to me and to the timeline barely enter their lives at all.

when i start talking about AI, self-driving cars, robots, rockets, all the things i’m insanely excited about, they mostly just scoff. completely uninterested.
and i don’t even mean any of this as an insult. a lot of them seem perfectly fine with their lives.

that’s what makes it so strange.
their lives now feel completely foreign to mine, while also being incredibly familiar.

we grew up in the same town, went to the same schools, knew the same people. our families and childhoods weren’t that different.

if i had made a couple different choices when i was 14 or 15, there’s a very real chance that would have been my life too.

sometimes you go home and realize just how many completely different versions of your life were only a few decisions away.

quoted_text:
做好日化产品有一个妙招，不要把重心放在追求物理参数上精益求精，而是应该关注如何让消费者换一个参照系。

展开讲原因之前，想先问问大家家里厨房水台是放一瓶洗洁精和一瓶洗手液嘛？

为啥这么问呢？因为我今天烧排骨，手上沾了一层猪油。用洗手液洗完还是滑的，后来顺手碰了点洗洁精，猪油瞬间没了。

我立马想：既然都是表面活性剂，都是搓一搓再冲掉，为什么厨房这个场景里里还要同时放一瓶洗手液和一瓶洗洁精？满手猪油时，直接用洗洁精不得了？最开始人类发明清洁剂的时候，应该也不会有这么细致的分类吧？

查完发现，二者不是“一个高级、一个低级”，而是KPI不同：
洗洁精：把油狠狠干掉。
洗手液：洗干净，但别洗得太干净。

洗手液要允许人一天使用很多次，所以必须牺牲一部分去油能力，换取温和、保湿和皮肤耐受。因此，洗手液不是智商税，它确实解决了真实问题。

但它也展示了一种很典型的商业逻辑：
人类最早只有通用肥皂，一套东西到处洗。后来才逐渐分成洗衣、洗碗、洗手、洗脸和洗澡，再继续切出厨房去味、泡沫滋润、抑菌呵护和le labo matcha 26🤣

每切出一个新场景，就创造一个新参照系；每创造一个新参照系，就获得一次重新定价的机会。

最近的网红甜品超长蛋挞也一样。听说湾区大华也有，我都超心动！和朋友约好去买哈哈，今天不知道为什么突然想把洗手液和蛋挞做个类比，普通蛋挞成本3块，卖6块5；超长蛋挞成本8块，卖16。

如果只看成本，超长蛋挞好像更贵；但如果看售价与成本的关系，普通蛋挞反而可能是利润更好的那个。

因为消费者比较普通蛋挞时，想的是“一个精致甜点值多少钱”；比较超长蛋挞时，想的却可能是“这么大，性价比高不高”。

商品没必要彻底改变。

改变参照系，消费者的价格逻辑就会跟着改变。

The Courtade–Kumar conjecture is finally cracked.

This massive 85-page paper delivers the first full proof: for any noisy n-bit vector, the best way to extract information is still the simplest—just track one bit (“dictator” functions). Nothing fancier works better.

Their approach turns the high-dimensional info theory puzzle into a two-variable Bellman inequality, solved with a blend of analytic tricks and certified computer checks. The result: for *every* Boolean function, I(g(X);Y) ≤ 1–H₂(p), with equality only for dictators.

Why this matters: it settles a top-tier open problem in information theory, gives new tools for analyzing noise, and shows how rigorous human–AI collaboration can speed up breakthroughs on deep math questions.
